<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, maximum-scale=1, user-scalable=no, viewport-fit=cover">
<title>Attendance Register</title>
<meta name="apple-mobile-web-app-capable" content="yes">
<meta name="apple-mobile-web-app-status-bar-style" content="black-translucent">
<meta name="apple-mobile-web-app-title" content="Register">
<meta name="mobile-web-app-capable" content="yes">
<meta name="theme-color" content="#241B3D">
<link rel="apple-touch-icon" href="data:image/png;base64,">
<link rel="icon" type="image/png" sizes="32x32" href="data:image/png;base64,">
<link rel="icon" type="image/png" sizes="512x512" href="data:image/png;base64,">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Fraunces:ital,wght@0,500;0,600;0,700;1,500&family=IBM+Plex+Mono:wght@400;500;600&family=Inter:wght@400;500;600;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<script src="https://accounts.google.com/gsi/client" async defer></script>
<style>
:root{
  --bg:#F6F4EE;
  --paper:#FBFAF5;
  --ink:#241B3D;
  --ink-soft:#5B5468;
  --stamp:#4F2D7F;
  --stamp-soft:#A98FC4;
  --present:#2F6B3E;
  --present-soft:#DCE9DE;
  --leave:#B8860B;
  --leave-soft:#F0E4C4;
  --holiday:#3D6B99;
  --holiday-soft:#DCE6F0;
  --absent:#8B2E2E;
  --absent-soft:#F0DCD9;
  --worked:#C97A2E;
  --worked-soft:#F3E1CC;
  --line:#DAD4C4;
  --line-soft:#EAE6DC;
  --shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(36,27,61,0.06),0 4px 14px rgba(36,27,61,0.05);
}
*{box-sizing:border-box;-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent;}
html,body{margin:0;padding:0;overflow-x:hidden;max-width:100vw;}
body{
  background:var(--bg);
  color:var(--ink);
  font-family:'Inter',sans-serif;
  min-height:100vh;
  padding-bottom:calc(24px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom));
  padding-top:calc(46px + env(safe-area-inset-top));
  padding-left:env(safe-area-inset-left);
  padding-right:env(safe-area-inset-right);
  -webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;
}
.wrap{max-width:640px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 16px;}
.hdr{
  padding:22px 16px 16px;
  background:var(--ink);
  color:var(--bg);
  border-bottom:3px solid var(--stamp);
  position:relative;
  overflow:hidden;
}
.hdr::after{
  content:"";
  position:absolute;
  right:-30px;top:-30px;
  width:140px;height:140px;
  border:1.5px solid rgba(246,244,238,0.08);
  border-radius:50%;
}
.hdr-inner{max-width:640px;margin:0 auto;position:relative;z-index:1;}
.hdr-eyebrow{
  font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace;
  font-size:11px;letter-spacing:2px;text-transform:uppercase;
  color:var(--stamp-soft);margin:0 0 4px;
}
.hdr h1{
  font-family:'Fraunces',serif;
  font-weight:600;font-size:24px;margin:0 0 2px;
  letter-spacing:-0.01em;
}
.hdr .firm{font-size:13px;color:rgba(246,244,238,0.65);margin:0 0 14px;}
.hdr-stats{display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;}
.stat-chip{
  background:rgba(246,244,238,0.08);
  border:1px solid rgba(246,244,238,0.14);
  border-radius:8px;
  padding:8px 12px;
  flex:1;min-width:120px;
}
.stat-chip.clickable{cursor:pointer;}
.stat-chip.clickable:active{background:rgba(246,244,238,0.16);}
.stat-chip .n{font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace;font-size:18px;font-weight:600;line-height:1;}
.stat-chip .l{font-size:10.5px;color:rgba(246,244,238,0.6);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:1px;margin-top:4px;}
.stat-chip.warn .n{color:#E8B4A8;}

.sync-row{
  margin-top:12px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;
  background:rgba(246,244,238,0.07);border:1px solid rgba(246,244,238,0.14);
  border-radius:8px;padding:8px 12px;font-size:12.5px;
}
.sync-row .sync-status{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;color:rgba(246,244,238,0.75);}
.sync-dot{width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;background:#8B9A8B;flex-shrink:0;}
.sync-dot.synced{background:#6FA97A;}
.sync-dot.syncing{background:#D9B34A;animation:pulse 1s infinite;}
.sync-dot.error{background:#D97F6E;}
@keyframes pulse{0%,100%{opacity:1;}50%{opacity:0.35;}}
.sync-row button{
  background:var(--stamp);color:#fff;border:none;border-radius:6px;
  padding:6px 12px;font-size:12px;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;font-family:'Inter',sans-serif;
}
.sync-row button.signed-in{background:none;border:1px solid rgba(246,244,238,0.3);color:rgba(246,244,238,0.8);}
.sync-row.connected{padding:6px 12px;}
.sync-row.connected button{display:none;}
.sync-row.connected #switchAccountBtn{display:inline-block;padding:4px 9px;font-size:11px;}

.lock-row{
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;
  background:var(--paper);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;
  padding:10px 14px;margin-bottom:14px;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:600;color:var(--ink-soft);
}
.lock-row.unlocked{background:var(--present-soft);border-color:var(--present);color:var(--present);}
.lock-row button{
  border:1.5px solid var(--stamp);color:var(--stamp);background:none;border-radius:7px;
  padding:6px 12px;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;font-family:'Inter',sans-serif;
}
.lock-row.unlocked button{border-color:var(--present);color:var(--present);}
.lock-banner{
  background:var(--absent-soft);color:var(--absent);border-radius:8px;padding:10px 12px;
  font-size:12.5px;margin-bottom:14px;font-weight:600;
}

.today-status{
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;border-radius:10px;padding:11px 14px;
  margin-bottom:12px;font-size:13px;font-weight:700;
}
.today-status.marked{background:var(--present-soft);color:var(--present);}
.today-status.unmarked{background:var(--leave-soft);color:var(--leave);}
.today-status .dot2{width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;flex-shrink:0;}
.today-status.marked .dot2{background:var(--present);}
.today-status.unmarked .dot2{background:var(--leave);}

.range-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:10px;}

/* Calendar (Log tab) */
.cal-card{background:var(--paper);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;padding:16px;box-shadow:var(--shadow);box-sizing:border-box;overflow:hidden;}
.cal-month-block{margin-bottom:22px;scroll-margin-top:70px;}
.cal-month-block:last-child{margin-bottom:4px;}
.cal-month-label{font-family:'Fraunces',serif;font-weight:600;font-size:15px;margin-bottom:8px;}
.cal-weekdays{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(7,minmax(0,1fr));text-align:center;font-size:10.5px;font-weight:700;color:var(--ink-soft);letter-spacing:0.5px;margin-bottom:4px;}
.cal-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(7,minmax(0,1fr));gap:3px;width:100%;box-sizing:border-box;}
.cal-day{
  aspect-ratio:1;width:100%;min-width:0;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;position:relative;
  border-radius:8px;font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:600;
  color:var(--ink);cursor:default;background:var(--line-soft);box-sizing:border-box;
}
.cal-day.empty{visibility:hidden;background:transparent;}
.cal-day.has-entry{cursor:pointer;color:#fff;}
.cal-day.has-entry:active{opacity:0.75;}
.cal-day.today{box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 2px var(--stamp);}
.cal-day.Present, .cal-day.WFH{background:var(--present);}
.cal-day.Leave, .cal-day.HalfDay{background:var(--leave);}
.cal-day.PublicHoliday{background:var(--holiday);}
.cal-day.Absent{background:var(--absent);}
.cal-day.HolidayWorked{background:var(--worked);}
.cal-legend{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px;margin-bottom:16px;padding-bottom:14px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);font-size:11.5px;color:var(--ink-soft);}
.cal-legend span{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;}
.cal-legend .dot{width:9px;height:9px;border-radius:50%;display:inline-block;}
.cal-legend .dot.Present{background:var(--present);}
.cal-legend .dot.Leave{background:var(--leave);}
.cal-legend .dot.PublicHoliday{background:var(--holiday);}
.cal-legend .dot.Absent{background:var(--absent);}
.cal-legend .dot.HolidayWorked{background:var(--worked);}

.day-detail dl{margin:0;}
.day-detail .dd-row{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;padding:8px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line-soft);font-size:13.5px;gap:12px;}
.day-detail .dd-row .dd-label{color:var(--ink-soft);flex-shrink:0;}
.day-detail .dd-row .dd-val{text-align:right;font-weight:600;}
.day-detail .dd-chips{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px;justify-content:flex-end;}
.day-detail button.btn-primary{margin-top:16px;}

/* Pie chart (Clients tab time-spent view) */
.pie-wrap{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:10px;margin-bottom:16px;}
.pie-chart{width:180px;height:180px;border-radius:50%;cursor:pointer;box-shadow:var(--shadow);transition:transform .15s;}
.pie-chart:active{transform:scale(0.97);}
.pie-view-label{font-size:11.5px;font-weight:700;color:var(--ink-soft);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:1.5px;}
.pie-legend{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:7px;}
.pie-legend-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-size:13px;}
.pie-legend-row .pie-dot{width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:50%;flex-shrink:0;}
.pie-legend-row .pl-label{flex:1;}
.pie-legend-row .pl-val{font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace;color:var(--ink-soft);font-size:12px;}

nav.tabs{
  position:fixed;top:0;left:0;right:0;z-index:50;
  display:flex;background:var(--paper);
  border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);
  max-width:640px;margin:0 auto;
  padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top);
}
nav.tabs button{
  flex:1;padding:13px 2px;background:none;border:none;
  font-family:'Inter',sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:600;
  color:var(--ink-soft);cursor:pointer;border-bottom:2.5px solid transparent;
  transition:color .15s, border-color .15s;
}
nav.tabs button.active{color:var(--stamp);border-bottom-color:var(--stamp);}

main{padding:18px 16px 40px;max-width:640px;margin:0 auto;}
.card{
  background:var(--paper);border:1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius:12px;padding:18px;margin-bottom:16px;box-shadow:var(--shadow);
}
.card h2{
  font-family:'Fraunces',serif;font-size:17px;font-weight:600;margin:0 0 14px;
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;
}
.card h2 .num{
  font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace;color:var(--stamp);font-size:12px;
  border:1px solid var(--stamp);border-radius:50%;width:20px;height:20px;
  display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex-shrink:0;
}
label{display:block;font-size:12px;font-weight:600;color:var(--ink-soft);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:0.5px;margin:14px 0 6px;}
label:first-of-type{margin-top:0;}
input[type=date], input[type=text], input[type=number], select, textarea{
  width:100%;padding:10px 12px;border:1.5px solid var(--line);border-radius:8px;
  font-family:'Inter',sans-serif;font-size:14.5px;background:#fff;color:var(--ink);
}
input:focus, select:focus, textarea:focus{outline:2px solid var(--stamp);outline-offset:1px;border-color:var(--stamp);}
textarea{resize:vertical;min-height:56px;}

.seg{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:6px;}
.seg button{
  padding:9px 4px;border:1.5px solid var(--line);border-radius:8px;background:#fff;
  font-size:12.5px;font-weight:600;color:var(--ink-soft);cursor:pointer;font-family:'Inter',sans-serif;
}
.seg button.sel[data-s="Present"]{background:var(--present-soft);border-color:var(--present);color:var(--present);}
.seg button.sel[data-s="Leave"]{background:var(--leave-soft);border-color:var(--leave);color:var(--leave);}
.seg button.sel[data-s="Public Holiday"]{background:var(--holiday-soft);border-color:var(--holiday);color:var(--holiday);}
.seg button.sel[data-s="Absent"]{background:var(--absent-soft);border-color:var(--absent);color:var(--absent);}
.seg button.sel[data-s="WFH"]{background:var(--present-soft);border-color:var(--present);color:var(--present);}
.seg button.sel[data-s="Half Day"]{background:var(--leave-soft);border-color:var(--leave);color:var(--leave);}

.chk-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;margin-top:12px;padding:10px 12px;background:var(--holiday-soft);border-radius:8px;}
.chk-row input{width:16px;height:16px;accent-color:var(--holiday);}
.chk-row span{font-size:13px;color:var(--ink);}

.work-row{
  display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr auto;gap:8px;margin-bottom:8px;align-items:center;
}
.work-row input{padding:9px 10px;font-size:13.5px;}
.work-row .rm{
  background:none;border:1.5px solid var(--line);color:var(--ink-soft);
  border-radius:8px;width:36px;height:36px;cursor:pointer;font-size:16px;line-height:1;
}
.add-work{
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;background:none;border:1.5px dashed var(--line);
  color:var(--stamp);font-weight:600;font-size:13px;padding:9px 12px;border-radius:8px;
  cursor:pointer;width:100%;margin-top:2px;font-family:'Inter',sans-serif;
}

.gt-firm-choice{grid-column:1 / -1;background:var(--line-soft);border-radius:8px;padding:10px;margin-top:2px;}
.gt-firm-seg{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:6px;}
.gt-firm-seg button{
  padding:8px 4px;border:1.5px solid var(--line);border-radius:8px;background:#fff;
  font-size:11.5px;font-weight:600;color:var(--ink-soft);cursor:pointer;font-family:'Inter',sans-serif;
}
.gt-firm-seg button.sel{background:var(--holiday-soft);border-color:var(--stamp);color:var(--stamp);}
.gt-firm-client-wrap select{margin-top:6px;}
.gt-firm-client-wrap select:first-child{margin-top:0;}

.btn-primary{
  width:100%;margin-top:18px;padding:14px;border:none;border-radius:9px;
  background:var(--stamp);color:#fff;font-family:'Inter',sans-serif;font-weight:700;
  font-size:15px;cursor:pointer;letter-spacing:0.3px;
}
.btn-primary:active{transform:scale(0.99);}
.btn-secondary{
  background:none;border:1.5px solid var(--line);color:var(--ink-soft);
  padding:8px 14px;border-radius:8px;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;font-family:'Inter',sans-serif;
}

/* Stamp overlay */
.stamp-overlay{
  position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(36,27,61,0.55);
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;z-index:100;
  opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transition:opacity .2s;
}
.stamp-overlay.show{opacity:1;pointer-events:auto;}
.stamp-badge{
  width:180px;height:180px;border-radius:50%;
  border:5px solid var(--stamp);
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  background:rgba(79,45,127,0.04);
  transform:scale(0.5) rotate(-18deg);opacity:0;
  transition:transform .35s cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1), opacity .2s;
}
.stamp-overlay.show .stamp-badge{transform:scale(1) rotate(-8deg);opacity:1;}
.stamp-badge .ring{
  position:absolute;width:150px;height:150px;border-radius:50%;border:1.5px solid var(--stamp);
}
.stamp-badge .txt1{font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace;font-weight:700;font-size:15px;color:var(--stamp);letter-spacing:1px;text-transform:uppercase;}
.stamp-badge .txt2{font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace;font-size:11px;color:var(--stamp);margin-top:4px;letter-spacing:1px;}

/* Log list */
.month-hd{font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace;font-size:12px;color:var(--ink-soft);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:1.5px;margin:22px 0 8px;padding-bottom:6px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);}
.month-hd:first-child{margin-top:0;}
.entry{
  display:flex;gap:12px;padding:11px 4px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line-soft);cursor:pointer;
}
.entry:active{background:var(--line-soft);}
.entry .dot{width:9px;height:9px;border-radius:50%;margin-top:5px;flex-shrink:0;}
.entry .dot.Present{background:var(--present);}
.entry .dot.WFH{background:var(--present);}
.entry .dot.Leave{background:var(--leave);}
.entry .dot.HalfDay{background:var(--leave);}
.entry .dot.PublicHoliday{background:var(--holiday);}
.entry .dot.Absent{background:var(--absent);}
.entry .body{flex:1;min-width:0;}
.entry .r1{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;}
.entry .date{font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace;font-size:13px;font-weight:600;}
.entry .status{font-size:11.5px;font-weight:600;color:var(--ink-soft);}
.entry .meta{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--ink-soft);margin-top:2px;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap;}
.entry .chips{display:flex;gap:5px;margin-top:5px;flex-wrap:wrap;}
.chip{background:var(--line-soft);border-radius:5px;padding:2px 7px;font-size:11px;color:var(--ink-soft);font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace;}

.filter-row{display:flex;gap:8px;margin-bottom:6px;}
.filter-row select{flex:1;padding:8px 10px;font-size:13px;}

.empty{text-align:center;padding:40px 20px;color:var(--ink-soft);}
.empty .big{font-family:'Fraunces',serif;font-size:16px;color:var(--ink);margin-bottom:6px;}

/* Balance */
.bal-row{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;padding:9px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line-soft);font-size:14px;}
.bal-row.sub{padding-left:14px;font-size:13px;color:var(--ink-soft);}
.bal-row .v{font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace;font-weight:600;}
.bal-row.total{border-top:2px solid var(--ink);border-bottom:none;margin-top:8px;padding-top:12px;font-weight:700;font-size:15.5px;}
.bal-row.final .v{color:var(--stamp);font-size:19px;}
.bal-hero{
  text-align:center;padding:22px 10px 26px;
}
.bal-hero .num{font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace;font-size:52px;font-weight:700;color:var(--stamp);line-height:1;}
.bal-hero .lbl{font-size:12px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:1.5px;color:var(--ink-soft);margin-top:8px;}
.progress-track{height:8px;background:var(--line-soft);border-radius:4px;overflow:hidden;margin-top:16px;}
.progress-fill{height:100%;background:var(--stamp);border-radius:4px;transition:width .4s;}

/* Clients */
.client-card{
  border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;padding:14px;margin-bottom:10px;background:#fff;
}
.client-card .cname{font-family:'Fraunces',serif;font-weight:600;font-size:15.5px;}
.client-card .cdays{font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace;font-size:13px;color:var(--stamp);font-weight:600;}
.client-card .crow{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:baseline;}
.period-tag{display:inline-block;background:var(--line-soft);border-radius:6px;padding:3px 8px;font-size:11.5px;margin:6px 4px 0 0;color:var(--ink-soft);}
.period-tag b{color:var(--ink);font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace;}
.bulk-period-row{display:flex;gap:6px;margin-top:10px;padding-top:10px;border-top:1px dashed var(--line);}
.bulk-period-row input{flex:1;padding:8px 10px;font-size:13px;}
.bulk-period-row button{white-space:nowrap;padding:8px 12px;}

/* Client registry */
.add-client-row{display:flex;gap:8px;margin-bottom:4px;}
.add-client-row input{flex:1;}
.add-client-row button{white-space:nowrap;padding:10px 14px;border:none;border-radius:8px;background:var(--stamp);color:#fff;font-weight:700;font-size:13px;cursor:pointer;font-family:'Inter',sans-serif;}
.registry-card{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;padding:14px;margin-bottom:10px;background:#fff;}
.registry-card .rname{font-family:'Fraunces',serif;font-weight:600;font-size:15.5px;}
.rname-row{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;}
.rname-row .rname-text{font-family:'Fraunces',serif;font-weight:600;font-size:15.5px;}
.rname-row .rename-btn{padding:5px 10px;font-size:11.5px;}
.period-list{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px;margin:8px 0;}
.period-pill{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;background:var(--line-soft);border-radius:6px;padding:4px 8px;font-size:12px;font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace;color:var(--ink);}
.period-pill button{background:none;border:none;color:var(--ink-soft);cursor:pointer;font-size:14px;line-height:1;padding:0;}
.add-period-row{display:flex;gap:6px;margin-top:6px;}
.add-period-row input{flex:1;padding:7px 9px;font-size:12.5px;}
.add-period-row button{padding:7px 11px;font-size:12px;white-space:nowrap;}
.registry-empty{text-align:center;padding:24px;color:var(--ink-soft);font-size:13.5px;}

/* Claims */
.claims-summary{display:flex;gap:10px;margin-bottom:14px;}
.claims-summary .cs-chip{flex:1;background:var(--paper);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;padding:12px;text-align:center;}
.claims-summary .cs-chip .n{font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace;font-size:22px;font-weight:700;}
.claims-summary .cs-chip.pending .n{color:var(--leave);}
.claims-summary .cs-chip.approved .n{color:var(--present);}
.claims-summary .cs-chip .l{font-size:10.5px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:1px;color:var(--ink-soft);margin-top:3px;}
.claim-row{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;padding:12px 14px;margin-bottom:8px;background:#fff;}
.claim-row .cr-top{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:baseline;}
.claim-row .cr-date{font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace;font-weight:600;font-size:13.5px;}
.claim-row .cr-tag{font-size:10.5px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:0.5px;padding:2px 7px;border-radius:5px;font-weight:700;}
.claim-row .cr-tag.Saturday, .claim-row .cr-tag.Sunday{background:var(--present-soft);color:var(--present);}
.claim-row .cr-tag.Holiday{background:var(--holiday-soft);color:var(--holiday);}
.claim-row .cr-meta{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--ink-soft);margin:5px 0 10px;}
.claim-row .cr-actions{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;}
.claim-badge{font-size:11.5px;font-weight:700;padding:4px 9px;border-radius:6px;}
.claim-badge.pending{background:var(--leave-soft);color:var(--leave);}
.claim-badge.approved{background:var(--present-soft);color:var(--present);}
.claim-row button.claim-toggle{border:none;border-radius:7px;padding:7px 13px;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;font-family:'Inter',sans-serif;}
.claim-row button.claim-toggle.approve{background:var(--present);color:#fff;}
.claim-row button.claim-toggle.unapprove{background:none;border:1.5px solid var(--line);color:var(--ink-soft);}

/* Install banner */
.install-banner{
  background:var(--holiday-soft);border:1px solid var(--holiday);border-radius:10px;
  padding:12px 14px;margin-bottom:16px;font-size:13px;color:var(--ink);display:none;
}
.install-banner.show{display:block;}
.install-banner b{color:var(--holiday);}

.toast{
  position:fixed;bottom:20px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(20px);
  background:var(--ink);color:#fff;padding:10px 18px;border-radius:8px;font-size:13px;
  opacity:0;transition:all .25s;z-index:200;pointer-events:none;
}
.toast.show{opacity:1;transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(0);}

.modal-bg{position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(36,27,61,0.5);z-index:90;display:none;align-items:flex-end;justify-content:center;}
.modal-bg.show{display:flex;}
.modal{background:var(--bg);width:100%;max-width:640px;max-height:88vh;overflow-y:auto;border-radius:16px 16px 0 0;padding:20px 16px 30px;}
.modal-hd{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;margin-bottom:14px;}
.modal-hd h3{font-family:'Fraunces',serif;font-size:17px;margin:0;}
.modal-hd button{background:none;border:none;font-size:22px;color:var(--ink-soft);cursor:pointer;padding:0 4px;}

::selection{background:var(--stamp-soft);}
/* iOS Safari auto-zooms on focus into any input/select/textarea under 16px \u2014
   this keeps every form field at 16px regardless of what a more specific rule set,
   so tapping a field never triggers that zoom-and-not-zoom-back behavior. */
input, select, textarea{font-size:16px !important;}
@media (max-width:380px){
  .stat-chip{min-width:100px;}
}

/* Auth & Subscription Overlay */
.auth-screen{
  position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:150;background:var(--bg);
  overflow-y:auto;padding:24px 16px 48px;display:none;
}
.auth-screen.show{display:block;}
.auth-container{max-width:500px;margin:0 auto;}
.auth-brand{
  background:var(--ink);color:var(--bg);border-radius:16px;padding:24px 20px;
  border-bottom:4px solid var(--stamp);margin-bottom:18px;position:relative;overflow:hidden;
  box-shadow:var(--shadow);
}
.auth-brand::after{
  content:"";position:absolute;right:-25px;top:-25px;width:120px;height:120px;
  border:1.5px solid rgba(246,244,238,0.1);border-radius:50%;
}
.auth-brand .eyebrow{
  font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:2px;
  text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--stamp-soft);margin:0 0 6px;
}
.auth-brand h1{
  font-family:'Fraunces',serif;font-size:26px;font-weight:600;margin:0 0 6px;
}
.auth-brand p{font-size:13px;color:rgba(246,244,238,0.75);margin:0;line-height:1.45;}
.auth-tabs{
  display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:8px;background:var(--line-soft);
  padding:5px;border-radius:10px;margin-bottom:16px;
}
.auth-tabs button{
  padding:10px;border:none;border-radius:7px;background:transparent;
  font-family:'Inter',sans-serif;font-weight:700;font-size:13.5px;color:var(--ink-soft);cursor:pointer;
}
.auth-tabs button.active{background:var(--paper);color:var(--stamp);box-shadow:var(--shadow);}
.auth-card{
  background:var(--paper);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;
  padding:20px 18px;box-shadow:var(--shadow);margin-bottom:16px;
}
.auth-card h2{
  font-family:'Fraunces',serif;font-size:18px;margin:0 0 4px;
}
.auth-card .sub{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--ink-soft);margin:0 0 14px;}
input[type=email], input[type=password]{
  width:100%;padding:10px 12px;border:1.5px solid var(--line);border-radius:8px;
  font-family:'Inter',sans-serif;font-size:16px !important;background:#fff;color:var(--ink);
}
input[type=email]:focus, input[type=password]:focus{
  outline:2px solid var(--stamp);outline-offset:1px;border-color:var(--stamp);
}
.calc-box{
  margin-top:10px;padding:12px 14px;background:var(--holiday-soft);
  border:1px solid var(--holiday);border-radius:10px;font-size:12.5px;color:var(--ink);
}
.calc-box .calc-row{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;margin-top:4px;}
.calc-box .calc-row:first-child{margin-top:0;}
.calc-box .calc-val{font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace;font-weight:700;color:var(--stamp);font-size:13.5px;}
.plan-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:8px;margin-top:8px;}
.plan-card{
  border:1.5px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;padding:12px 14px;background:#fff;
  cursor:pointer;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;transition:all .15s;
}
.plan-card.sel{border-color:var(--stamp);background:rgba(79,45,127,0.05);box-shadow:0 0 0 1px var(--stamp);}
.plan-card .p-title{font-weight:700;font-size:14px;color:var(--ink);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;}
.plan-card .p-desc{font-size:11.5px;color:var(--ink-soft);margin-top:2px;}
.plan-card .p-price{font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace;font-weight:700;font-size:14px;color:var(--stamp);text-align:right;}
.plan-badge{
  background:var(--stamp);color:#fff;font-size:10px;padding:2px 6px;border-radius:4px;
  text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:0.5px;font-weight:700;
}
.pay-methods{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:6px;margin-top:6px;}
.pay-methods button{
  padding:8px 6px;border:1.5px solid var(--line);border-radius:8px;background:#fff;
  font-size:12px;font-weight:600;color:var(--ink-soft);cursor:pointer;font-family:'Inter',sans-serif;
}
.pay-methods button.sel{border-color:var(--stamp);background:var(--holiday-soft);color:var(--stamp);}
.demo-accounts{
  margin-top:14px;padding-top:14px;border-top:1px dashed var(--line);
}
.demo-accounts .da-lbl{font-size:11px;font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:0.8px;color:var(--ink-soft);margin-bottom:8px;}
.demo-chip-row{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;}
.demo-chip{
  flex:1;min-width:180px;text-align:left;background:var(--line-soft);border:1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius:8px;padding:8px 10px;cursor:pointer;font-family:'Inter',sans-serif;
}
.demo-chip:active{background:var(--line);}
.demo-chip .dc-name{font-weight:700;font-size:12.5px;color:var(--ink);}
.demo-chip .dc-meta{font-size:11px;color:var(--ink-soft);font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace;margin-top:2px;}

/* Header user & subscription controls */
.hdr-top-bar{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-start;gap:10px;}
.sub-pill-row{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px;align-items:center;margin-bottom:12px;}
.sub-pill{
  display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace;
  font-size:10.5px;font-weight:600;padding:3px 9px;border-radius:999px;
  background:rgba(111,169,122,0.2);color:#A8E0B1;border:1px solid rgba(111,169,122,0.4);
}
.sub-pill.expired{background:rgba(217,127,110,0.2);color:#F2B8B0;border-color:rgba(217,127,110,0.45);}
.period-span-pill{
  display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace;
  font-size:10.5px;padding:3px 9px;border-radius:999px;
  background:rgba(246,244,238,0.08);color:rgba(246,244,238,0.8);border:1px solid rgba(246,244,238,0.16);
}
.hdr-actions{display:flex;gap:6px;flex-shrink:0;}
.hdr-btn{
  background:rgba(246,244,238,0.1);border:1px solid rgba(246,244,238,0.22);color:var(--bg);
  border-radius:7px;padding:6px 10px;font-size:11.5px;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;font-family:'Inter',sans-serif;
}
.hdr-btn:active{background:rgba(246,244,238,0.2);}

</style>
</head>
<body>

<div class="hdr">
  <div class="hdr-inner">
    <div class="hdr-top-bar">
      <div>
        <p class="hdr-eyebrow">Attendance Register</p>
        <h1 id="userName">Abdullah Abdur Raheem</h1>
        <p class="firm" id="userFirm">Grant Thornton Anjum Rahman &middot; Articleship</p>
      </div>
      <div class="hdr-actions">
        <button type="button" class="hdr-btn" id="openProfileModalBtn">Account &amp; Plan</button>
        <button type="button" class="hdr-btn" id="logoutBtn">Log out</button>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="sub-pill-row">
      <span class="sub-pill" id="hdrSubBadge">&#9679; Active Subscriber</span>
      <span class="period-span-pill" id="hdrArticleshipSpan">01 Aug 2024 &rarr; 31 Jan 2028 (3.5 yrs)</span>
    </div>
    <div class="hdr-stats">
      <div class="stat-chip clickable" id="dayCountChip"><div class="n" id="dayCount">&mdash;</div><div class="l">Day of articleship</div></div>
      <div class="stat-chip clickable" id="daysLeftChip"><div class="n" id="daysLeft">&mdash;</div><div class="l">Days remaining</div></div>
      <div class="stat-chip clickable" id="balChip"><div class="n" id="balMini">&mdash;</div><div class="l">Est. leave balance</div></div>
    </div>
    <div class="sync-row" id="syncRow">
      <div class="sync-status"><span class="sync-dot" id="syncDot"></span><span id="syncLabel">Not signed in</span></div>
      <button id="syncBtn">Sign in with Google</button>
      <button id="switchAccountBtn" style="display:none;">Switch account</button>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<nav class="tabs">
  <button class="tab-btn active" data-tab="today">Today</button>
  <button class="tab-btn" data-tab="log">Log</button>
  <button class="tab-btn" data-tab="balance">Balance</button>
  <button class="tab-btn" data-tab="claims">Claims</button>
  <button class="tab-btn" data-tab="clients">Clients</button>
</nav>

<main>
  <div class="install-banner" id="installBanner"></div>

  <!-- TODAY TAB -->
  <section id="tab-today">
    <div class="today-status" id="todayStatusBanner"></div>
    <div class="lock-row" id="lockRow">
      <span id="lockStatusText">&#128274; Register locked</span>
      <button type="button" id="lockToggleBtn">Unlock to edit</button>
    </div>
    <div class="card">
      <div class="lock-banner" id="lockBanner" style="display:none">This day is already recorded. Tap "Unlock to edit" above to change it.</div>
      <h2><span class="num">1</span> Mark a day</h2>
      <label>Date</label>
      <input type="date" id="f-date">

      <label>Attendance</label>
      <div class="seg" id="statusSeg">
        <button type="button" data-s="Present">Present</button>
        <button type="button" data-s="Leave">Leave</button>
        <button type="button" data-s="Public Holiday">Holiday</button>
        <button type="button" data-s="Absent">Absent</button>
        <button type="button" data-s="WFH">WFH</button>
        <button type="button" data-s="Half Day">Half Day</button>
      </div>

      <div class="chk-row">
        <input type="checkbox" id="f-holidayworked">
        <span>This is a Saturday / Sunday / public holiday I'm still working</span>
      </div>

      <label>Rotation / Department</label>
      <select id="f-dept">
        <option value="Corporate">Corporate</option>
        <option value="Audit">Audit</option>
        <option value="Tax">Tax</option>
        <option value="Advisory">Advisory</option>
        <option value="Secondment">Secondment</option>
      </select>

      <label>Client(s) &amp; audit period worked</label>
      <div id="workRows"></div>
      <button type="button" class="add-work" id="addWorkBtn">&plus; Add another client (split day)</button>

      <div id="remarkGroup" style="display:none">
        <label>Remark category <span style="color:var(--stamp)">*</span></label>
        <select id="f-remark">
          <option value="">Select a category...</option>
          <option>Others</option>
          <option>Winter 2025</option>
          <option>Summer 2026</option>
          <option>Winter 2026</option>
          <option>Summer 2027</option>
          <option>Winter 2027</option>
        </select>

        <label>Reason / note (optional)</label>
        <textarea id="f-reason" placeholder="e.g. reached late, exam prep, client site visit..."></textarea>
      </div>

      <button class="btn-primary" id="saveBtn">Save &amp; stamp</button>
      <button type="button" class="btn-secondary" id="deleteEntryBtn" style="display:none;margin-top:10px;width:100%;background:none;border-color:var(--absent);color:var(--absent);">Delete this day's entry</button>
    </div>
  </section>

  <!-- LOG TAB -->
  <section id="tab-log" style="display:none">
    <div class="cal-card">
      <div class="cal-legend">
        <span><i class="dot Present"></i>Present</span>
        <span><i class="dot Leave"></i>Leave</span>
        <span><i class="dot PublicHoliday"></i>Holiday</span>
        <span><i class="dot Absent"></i>Absent</span>
        <span><i class="dot HolidayWorked"></i>Worked (Sat/Sun/Holiday)</span>
      </div>
      <div id="calScroll"></div>
    </div>
  </section>

  <!-- BALANCE TAB -->
  <section id="tab-balance" style="display:none">
    <div class="card">
      <h2><span class="num">1</span> Mark leave for a date range</h2>
      <p style="font-size:12px;color:var(--ink-soft);margin:0 0 4px;">Fills every day in the range as Leave with the details below \u2014 useful for a multi-day application that's already been approved.</p>
      <div class="range-grid">
        <div><label>Start date</label><input type="date" id="lr-start"></div>
        <div><label>End date</label><input type="date" id="lr-end"></div>
      </div>
      <label>Remark category <span style="color:var(--stamp)">*</span></label>
      <select id="lr-remark">
        <option value="">Select a category...</option>
        <option>Others</option>
        <option>Winter 2025</option>
        <option>Summer 2026</option>
        <option>Winter 2026</option>
        <option>Summer 2027</option>
        <option>Winter 2027</option>
      </select>
      <label>Rotation / Department</label>
      <select id="lr-dept">
        <option value="Corporate">Corporate</option>
        <option value="Audit">Audit</option>
        <option value="Tax">Tax</option>
        <option value="Advisory">Advisory</option>
        <option value="Secondment">Secondment</option>
      </select>
      <label>Reason / note (optional)</label>
      <textarea id="lr-reason" placeholder="e.g. approved application ref #..."></textarea>
      <button class="btn-primary" id="markRangeBtn">Fill attendance for this range</button>
    </div>
    <div class="card">
      <div class="bal-hero">
        <div class="num" id="balHeroNum">&mdash;</div>
        <div class="lbl">Estimated leave balance</div>
        <div class="progress-track"><div class="progress-fill" id="balProgress"></div></div>
      </div>
      <div class="bal-row"><span>Leaves allowed</span><span class="v" id="b-allowed">130</span></div>
      <div class="bal-row sub"><span>+ Saturdays worked (firm-approved)</span><span class="v" id="b-sat">0</span></div>
      <div class="bal-row sub"><span>+ Sundays worked (firm-approved)</span><span class="v" id="b-sun">0</span></div>
      <div class="bal-row sub"><span>+ Public holidays worked (firm-approved)</span><span class="v" id="b-ph">0</span></div>
      <div class="bal-row"><span>Exam leave taken (all sessions)</span><span class="v" id="b-exam">0</span></div>
      <div class="bal-row"><span>Other leave / absence</span><span class="v" id="b-others">0</span></div>
      <div class="bal-row total"><span>Leave balance</span><span class="v" id="b-total">0</span></div>
      <div class="bal-row"><span>Manual adjustment (vs GTAR's system)</span>
        <input type="number" id="b-adj" style="width:70px;padding:4px 6px;text-align:right;font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace;">
      </div>
      <div class="bal-row final"><span>Estimated per GTAR</span><span class="v" id="b-final">0</span></div>
    </div>
    <div class="card">
      <h2><span class="num">i</span> Exam leave breakdown</h2>
      <div id="examBreakdown"></div>
    </div>
    <div class="card">
      <h2><span class="num">&#9881;</span> Settings</h2>
      <label>Total leaves allowed (over full articleship)</label>
      <input type="number" id="s-allowed" value="130">
      <button class="btn-secondary" style="margin-top:12px" id="saveSettingsBtn">Save settings</button>
    </div>
    <div class="card">
      <h2><span class="num">&#8644;</span> Backup &amp; merge</h2>
      <p style="font-size:12px;color:var(--ink-soft);margin:0 0 12px;">Use this to combine data that ended up in two different Google accounts. Export on the device with the account you're moving away from, transfer the file to the other device (email, AirDrop, etc.), then import it there. Merging never overwrites a day that's already recorded here \u2014 it only adds days that are missing.</p>
      <button class="btn-secondary" id="exportDataBtn">Export current data</button>
      <label style="margin-top:16px;">Import a backup file</label>
      <input type="file" id="importFileInput" accept="application/json">
      <button class="btn-primary" style="margin-top:10px" id="importMergeBtn">Merge imported file into this device</button>
    </div>
  </section>

  <!-- CLAIMS TAB -->
  <section id="tab-claims" style="display:none">
    <div class="claims-summary">
      <div class="cs-chip pending"><div class="n" id="claimsPendingCount">0</div><div class="l">Pending</div></div>
      <div class="cs-chip approved"><div class="n" id="claimsApprovedCount">0</div><div class="l">Approved</div></div>
    </div>
    <div id="claimsList"></div>
  </section>

  <!-- CLIENTS TAB -->
  <section id="tab-clients" style="display:none">
    <div class="card">
      <h2><span class="num">&#128202;</span> Time spent</h2>
      <div class="pie-wrap">
        <div class="pie-chart" id="pieChart"></div>
        <div class="pie-view-label" id="pieViewLabel">By department</div>
      </div>
      <div class="pie-legend" id="pieLegend"></div>
      <p style="font-size:11.5px;color:var(--ink-soft);margin-top:10px;text-align:center;">Tap the chart to switch between department and client view</p>
    </div>
    <div class="card">
      <h2><span class="num">1</span> Clients</h2>
      <p style="font-size:12px;color:var(--ink-soft);margin:0 0 12px;">Only registered clients show up when you mark attendance on the Today tab.</p>
      <button type="button" class="btn-primary" id="openAddClientBtn" style="width:100%;">&plus; Add client</button>
    </div>
    <div id="clientsRegistryList"></div>
  </section>
</main>

<div class="modal-bg" id="addClientModalBg">
  <div class="modal">
    <div class="modal-hd"><h3>Add a client</h3><button id="closeAddClientModal">&times;</button></div>
    <label>Client name</label>
    <input type="text" id="newClientNameInput" placeholder="e.g. Pak China Investment Company Limited">
    <label>Audit period (optional)</label>
    <input type="text" id="newClientPeriodInput" placeholder="e.g. Jun 30, 2025">
    <label>Department</label>
    <select id="newClientDeptInput">
      <option value="Corporate">Corporate</option>
      <option value="Audit">Audit</option>
      <option value="Tax">Tax</option>
      <option value="Advisory">Advisory</option>
      <option value="Secondment">Secondment</option>
    </select>
    <p style="font-size:11.5px;color:var(--ink-soft);margin:6px 0 0;">Only clients in the department you currently have selected on the Today tab will show up when marking attendance.</p>
    <button type="button" class="btn-primary" id="confirmAddClientBtn" style="margin-top:16px;width:100%;">Add client</button>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="stamp-overlay" id="stampOverlay">
  <div class="stamp-badge" id="stampBadge">
    <div class="ring"></div>
    <div class="txt1" id="stampTxt1">Present</div>
    <div class="txt2" id="stampTxt2">Marked</div>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="modal-bg" id="editModalBg">
  <div class="modal">
    <div class="modal-hd"><h3>Edit entry</h3><button id="closeModal">&times;</button></div>
    <div id="editModalBody"></div>
  </div>
</div>


<!-- AUTH & SUBSCRIPTION OVERLAY -->
<div class="auth-screen" id="authScreen">
  <div class="auth-container">
    <div class="auth-brand">
      <p class="eyebrow">Articleship Attendance Register</p>
      <h1>Colleague Portal</h1>
      <p>Individual cloud-ready attendance, client audit period tracking, and automatic 3.5-year articleship leave balance register.</p>
    </div>

    <div class="auth-tabs">
      <button type="button" class="active" id="tabLoginBtn">Log In</button>
      <button type="button" id="tabSignupBtn">Sign Up &amp; Subscribe</button>
    </div>

    <!-- LOGIN PANEL -->
    <div class="auth-card" id="loginPanel">
      <h2>Welcome back</h2>
      <p class="sub">Sign in with your individual email and password to access your personal attendance register.</p>
      <label>Email address</label>
      <input type="email" id="loginEmail" placeholder="you@firm.com" autocomplete="username">
      <label>Password</label>
      <input type="password" id="loginPassword" placeholder="Enter your password" autocomplete="current-password">
      <button type="button" class="btn-primary" id="loginSubmitBtn">Sign in to Register</button>

      <div class="demo-accounts">
        <div class="da-lbl">Saved Accounts on this Device (1-Tap Sign In)</div>
        <div class="demo-chip-row" id="savedAccountsList"></div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- SIGNUP & SUBSCRIPTION PANEL -->
    <div class="auth-card" id="signupPanel" style="display:none;">
      <h2>Create your account</h2>
      <p class="sub">Set up your 3.5-year articleship timeline, choose a subscription plan, and start recording your own clients &amp; attendance.</p>

      <label>Full name <span style="color:var(--stamp)">*</span></label>
      <input type="text" id="suName" placeholder="e.g. Hamza Tariq">

      <label>Email address (Login ID) <span style="color:var(--stamp)">*</span></label>
      <input type="email" id="suEmail" placeholder="e.g. hamza.tariq@gtar.pk" autocomplete="username">

      <label>Password <span style="color:var(--stamp)">*</span></label>
      <input type="password" id="suPassword" placeholder="Create a password (min 4 chars)" autocomplete="new-password">

      <label>Firm / Organization</label>
      <input type="text" id="suFirm" value="Grant Thornton Anjum Rahman" placeholder="e.g. Grant Thornton Anjum Rahman">

      <div class="range-grid">
        <div>
          <label>Articleship start date <span style="color:var(--stamp)">*</span></label>
          <input type="date" id="suStartDate">
        </div>
        <div>
          <label>Leaves allowed (3.5 yrs)</label>
          <input type="number" id="suAllowedLeaves" value="130">
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="calc-box" id="suTimelinePreview">
        <div class="calc-row">
          <span>Articleship Start:</span>
          <span class="calc-val" id="suPreviewStart">&mdash;</span>
        </div>
        <div class="calc-row">
          <span>Auto-Calculated End (3.5 Years / 42 Mos):</span>
          <span class="calc-val" id="suPreviewEnd">&mdash;</span>
        </div>
        <div class="calc-row">
          <span>Total Articleship Span:</span>
          <span class="calc-val" id="suPreviewDays">&mdash;</span>
        </div>
      </div>

      <label style="margin-top:18px;">Select subscription plan <span style="color:var(--stamp)">*</span></label>
      <div class="plan-grid" id="suPlanGrid">
        <div class="plan-card" data-plan="monthly">
          <div>
            <div class="p-title">Monthly Plan</div>
            <div class="p-desc">Flexible monthly access &middot; Full attendance &amp; client tracker</div>
          </div>
          <div class="p-price">PKR 499<br><span style="font-size:10.5px;color:var(--ink-soft);font-weight:500;">/ month</span></div>
        </div>
        <div class="plan-card sel" data-plan="annual">
          <div>
            <div class="p-title">Annual Plan <span class="plan-badge">Popular</span></div>
            <div class="p-desc">Save 25% &middot; Billed yearly for active trainees</div>
          </div>
          <div class="p-price">PKR 4,499<br><span style="font-size:10.5px;color:var(--ink-soft);font-weight:500;">/ year</span></div>
        </div>
        <div class="plan-card" data-plan="lifetime">
          <div>
            <div class="p-title">Full 3.5-Year Articleship Pass <span class="plan-badge">Best Value</span></div>
            <div class="p-desc">One-time payment covering your entire 3.5-year articleship</div>
          </div>
          <div class="p-price">PKR 11,999<br><span style="font-size:10.5px;color:var(--ink-soft);font-weight:500;">full 3.5 yrs</span></div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <label>Payment method</label>
      <div class="pay-methods" id="suPayMethods">
        <button type="button" class="sel" data-pay="card">Debit / Credit</button>
        <button type="button" data-pay="wallet">JazzCash / EasyPaisa</button>
        <button type="button" data-pay="code">Firm / Promo Code</button>
      </div>

      <div id="payFieldsCard">
        <label>Cardholder &amp; Card Number</label>
        <input type="text" id="suCardNumber" placeholder="4242 •••• •••• 4242" value="4242 8810 3921 4242">
      </div>
      <div id="payFieldsWallet" style="display:none;">
        <label>Mobile Wallet Number (JazzCash / EasyPaisa)</label>
        <input type="text" id="suWalletNumber" placeholder="0300-1234567">
      </div>
      <div id="payFieldsCode" style="display:none;">
        <label>Colleague / Subscription Access Code</label>
        <input type="text" id="suPromoCode" placeholder="e.g. GTAR2026 or ARTICLES35">
      </div>

      <button type="button" class="btn-primary" id="signupSubmitBtn">Subscribe &amp; Start Recording Attendance</button>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<!-- ACCOUNT & SUBSCRIPTION SETTINGS MODAL -->
<div class="modal-bg" id="profileModalBg">
  <div class="modal">
    <div class="modal-hd"><h3>Account, Timeline &amp; Subscription</h3><button type="button" id="closeProfileModal">&times;</button></div>
    <label>Full name</label>
    <input type="text" id="profNameInput">
    <label>Email (Login ID)</label>
    <input type="email" id="profEmailInput" disabled style="background:var(--line-soft);color:var(--ink-soft);">
    <label>Firm / Organization</label>
    <input type="text" id="profFirmInput">
    <div class="range-grid">
      <div>
        <label>Articleship start date</label>
        <input type="date" id="profStartInput">
      </div>
      <div>
        <label>Auto-calculated end (3.5 yrs)</label>
        <input type="date" id="profEndInput" disabled style="background:var(--line-soft);color:var(--ink-soft);">
      </div>
    </div>
    <p style="font-size:11.5px;color:var(--ink-soft);margin:6px 0 0;">Your ending date is automatically calculated as exactly 3.5 years (42 months) from your articleship start date.</p>

    <div class="calc-box" style="margin-top:14px;">
      <div class="calc-row">
        <span>Subscription Plan:</span>
        <span class="calc-val" id="profPlanLabel">Full 3.5-Year Pass</span>
      </div>
      <div class="calc-row">
        <span>Status:</span>
        <span class="calc-val" id="profSubStatusLabel">Active</span>
      </div>
      <div class="calc-row">
        <span>Valid Until:</span>
        <span class="calc-val" id="profSubExpiryLabel">&mdash;</span>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div style="display:flex;gap:8px;margin-top:12px;">
      <button type="button" class="btn-secondary" id="toggleSubStatusBtn" style="flex:1;">Simulate Expiry / Renew</button>
      <button type="button" class="btn-secondary" id="upgradePlanBtn" style="flex:1;border-color:var(--stamp);color:var(--stamp);">Switch to 3.5Y Pass</button>
    </div>

    <button type="button" class="btn-primary" id="saveProfileBtn" style="margin-top:16px;">Save profile &amp; timeline</button>
  </div>
</div>

<!-- DELETE CONFIRMATION MODAL (Canvas-safe replacement for confirm()) -->
<div class="modal-bg" id="confirmDeleteModalBg">
  <div class="modal">
    <div class="modal-hd"><h3>Delete attendance entry?</h3><button type="button" id="closeConfirmDeleteModal">&times;</button></div>
    <p id="confirmDeleteText" style="font-size:14px;color:var(--ink-soft);margin:0 0 18px;line-height:1.5;"></p>
    <div style="display:flex;gap:10px;">
      <button type="button" class="btn-secondary" id="cancelDeleteBtn" style="flex:1;padding:12px;">Cancel</button>
      <button type="button" class="btn-primary" id="confirmDeleteYesBtn" style="flex:1;margin-top:0;background:var(--absent);">Delete entry</button>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

// Runs on every load, whether entries came from the bundled seed, localStorage, or
// Drive \u2014 corrects any leftover old placeholder client names in already-saved data.
function migrateClientNames(){
  Object.values(entries).forEach(e=>{
    (e.work||[]).forEach(w=>{
      const mapped = CLIENT_RENAME_MAP[w.client];
      if(mapped){
        w.client = mapped[0];
        if(!w.period) w.period = mapped[1];
      }
    });
  });
  FIRM_DATES.forEach(d=>{
    const e = entries[d];
    if(e && (!e.work || e.work.length===0)){
      e.work = [{client:'GT - Islamabad', period:null}];
    }
  });
  Object.keys(CLIENT_RENAME_MAP).forEach(oldKey=>{
    if(clients[oldKey]){
      const [newName, defaultPeriod] = CLIENT_RENAME_MAP[oldKey];
      if(!clients[newName]) clients[newName] = {periods:[]};
      (clients[oldKey].periods||[]).forEach(p=>{ if(!clients[newName].periods.includes(p)) clients[newName].periods.push(p); });
      if(defaultPeriod && !clients[newName].periods.includes(defaultPeriod)) clients[newName].periods.push(defaultPeriod);
      delete clients[oldKey];
    }
  });
  if(!clients['GT - Islamabad'] && FIRM_DATES.some(d=>entries[d])) clients['GT - Islamabad'] = {periods:[]};
}
// Assigns a default department to any client that doesn't have one yet (e.g. clients
// that existed before the department-filtering feature was added). GT - Islamabad is
// exempt — it's always shown regardless of which department is selected.
function migrateClientDepartments(){
  Object.keys(clients).forEach(name=>{
    if(name === 'GT - Islamabad') return;
    if(!clients[name].dept) clients[name].dept = 'Audit';
  });
}

// Automatically calculates the ending date 3.5 years (42 calendar months minus 1 day) from the start date.
// Example: 2024-08-01 -> 2028-01-31
function calculateArticleshipEndDate(startStr){
  if(!startStr) return '';
  const parts = startStr.split('-').map(Number);
  if(parts.length !== 3 || isNaN(parts[0])) return '';
  const [y, m, d] = parts;
  // Add 42 months (3.5 years), then subtract 1 day
  const endD = new Date(y, (m - 1) + 42, d);
  endD.setDate(endD.getDate() - 1);
  return endD.getFullYear() + '-' + String(endD.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,'0') + '-' + String(endD.getDate()).padStart(2,'0');
}

function todayStr(){
  const d = new Date();
  return d.getFullYear()+'-'+String(d.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,'0')+'-'+String(d.getDate()).padStart(2,'0');
}
function dayName(dateStr){
  const d = new Date(dateStr+'T00:00:00');
  return ['Sunday','Monday','Tuesday','Wednesday','Thursday','Friday','Saturday'][d.getDay()];
}
function fmtDate(dateStr){
  const d = new Date(dateStr+'T00:00:00');
  return d.toLocaleDateString('en-GB',{day:'2-digit',month:'short',year:'numeric'});
}
function monthKey(dateStr){ return dateStr.slice(0,7); }
function monthLabel(mk){
  const [y,m] = mk.split('-');
  return new Date(y, m-1, 1).toLocaleDateString('en-US',{month:'long',year:'numeric'});
}
function showToast(msg){
  const t = document.getElementById('toast');
  t.textContent = msg; t.classList.add('show');
  setTimeout(()=>t.classList.remove('show'), 2200);
}

// Uses the browser's own localStorage as the instant offline cache, and syncs
// through Google Drive (a small file in the app's private appData space) so the
// same data is available on any device you sign in on.
function buildDefaultAbdullahAccount(){
  const seedEntries = {};
  try{
    const legacyRaw = localStorage.getItem('leave-tracker-entries-v1');
    if(legacyRaw){
      Object.assign(seedEntries, JSON.parse(legacyRaw));
    } else {
      SEED_DATA.forEach(r=>{
        seedEntries[r.date] = {
          date:r.date, day:r.day, status:r.status, dept:r.dept,
          holidayWorked:false, work:r.work||[], remark:r.remark||'', reason:r.reason||'',
          claimApproved:false
        };
      });
    }
  }catch(e){
    SEED_DATA.forEach(r=>{
      seedEntries[r.date] = {
        date:r.date, day:r.day, status:r.status, dept:r.dept,
        holidayWorked:false, work:r.work||[], remark:r.remark||'', reason:r.reason||'',
        claimApproved:false
      };
    });
  }
  let seedSettings = { allowed: 130, adjustment: -10, locked: true };
  try{
    const sraw = localStorage.getItem('leave-tracker-settings-v1');
    if(sraw) seedSettings = JSON.parse(sraw);
  }catch(e){}
  let seedClients = {};
  try{
    const craw = localStorage.getItem('leave-tracker-clients-v1');
    if(craw) seedClients = JSON.parse(craw);
  }catch(e){}
  let seedDeleted = {};
  try{
    const draw = localStorage.getItem('leave-tracker-deleted-v1');
    if(draw) seedDeleted = JSON.parse(draw);
  }catch(e){}

  return {
    name: 'Abdullah Abdur Raheem',
    email: 'abdullah@gtar.pk',
    password: 'password123',
    firm: 'Grant Thornton Anjum Rahman',
    articleshipStart: '2024-08-01',
    articleshipEnd: calculateArticleshipEndDate('2024-08-01'),
    subscription: {
      plan: 'Full 3.5-Year Articleship Pass',
      planCode: 'lifetime',
      status: 'active',
      expiry: '2028-01-31'
    },
    entries: seedEntries,
    settings: seedSettings,
    clients: seedClients,
    deletedEntries: seedDeleted
  };
}

function saveUsersDb(){
  try{
    localStorage.setItem('leave-tracker-users-db-v2', JSON.stringify(usersDb));
    if(currentUserEmail){
      localStorage.setItem('leave-tracker-current-user-v2', currentUserEmail);
    } else {
      localStorage.removeItem('leave-tracker-current-user-v2');
    }
  }catch(e){ console.error('users db save error', e); }
}

function syncActiveUserToDb(){
  if(!currentUserEmail || !usersDb[currentUserEmail]) return;
  usersDb[currentUserEmail].entries = entries;
  usersDb[currentUserEmail].settings = settings;
  usersDb[currentUserEmail].clients = clients;
  usersDb[currentUserEmail].deletedEntries = deletedEntries;
  usersDb[currentUserEmail].articleshipStart = ARTICLESHIP_START;
  usersDb[currentUserEmail].articleshipEnd = ARTICLESHIP_END;
  saveUsersDb();
}

async function loadData(){
  try{
    const dbRaw = localStorage.getItem('leave-tracker-users-db-v2');
    if(dbRaw){
      usersDb = JSON.parse(dbRaw);
    }
  }catch(e){ console.error('db load error', e); }

  if(!usersDb['abdullah@gtar.pk']){
    usersDb['abdullah@gtar.pk'] = buildDefaultAbdullahAccount();
  }
  if(!usersDb['sara.khan@gtar.pk']){
    usersDb['sara.khan@gtar.pk'] = buildSampleColleagueAccount();
  }

  let hasSavedSession = false;
  try{
    const savedUser = localStorage.getItem('leave-tracker-current-user-v2');
    if(savedUser && usersDb[savedUser]){
      currentUserEmail = savedUser;
      hasSavedSession = true;
    } else {
      currentUserEmail = 'abdullah@gtar.pk';
    }
  }catch(e){
    currentUserEmail = 'abdullah@gtar.pk';
  }

  loadUserSession(currentUserEmail);
  if(!hasSavedSession){
    setTimeout(()=>showAuthScreen('login'), 50);
  }
}

function loadUserSession(email){
  const u = usersDb[email];
  if(!u) return;
  currentUserEmail = email;
  ARTICLESHIP_START = u.articleshipStart || '2024-08-01';
  ARTICLESHIP_END = u.articleshipEnd || calculateArticleshipEndDate(ARTICLESHIP_START);
  u.articleshipEnd = ARTICLESHIP_END;

  entries = u.entries || {};
  settings = u.settings || { allowed: 130, adjustment: 0, locked: true };
  clients = u.clients || {};
  deletedEntries = u.deletedEntries || {};

  Object.values(entries).forEach(e=>{ if(e.claimApproved===undefined) e.claimApproved=false; });
  const DEPT_MAP = {'Articles - Corporate':'Corporate','Articles - Audit':'Audit','Articles - Tax':'Tax','Articles - Advisory':'Advisory'};
  Object.values(entries).forEach(e=>{ if(DEPT_MAP[e.dept]) e.dept = DEPT_MAP[e.dept]; });
  if(settings.locked===undefined) settings.locked = true;

  if(email === 'abdullah@gtar.pk'){
    if(!Object.keys(clients).length) bootstrapClientsFromEntries();
    migrateClientNames();
  } else {
    if(!clients['GT - Islamabad']) clients['GT - Islamabad'] = { periods: [] };
  }
  migrateClientDepartments();
  calendarBuilt = false;
  populateRemarkDropdowns();
  syncActiveUserToDb();
}
// One-time bootstrap: register every client name already appearing in historical
// work entries, so old data keeps working under the new "registered clients only" rule.
function bootstrapClientsFromEntries(){
  Object.values(entries).forEach(e=>{
    (e.work||[]).forEach(w=>{
      if(!w.client) return;
      if(!clients[w.client]) clients[w.client] = { periods: [] };
      if(w.period && !clients[w.client].periods.includes(w.period)){
        clients[w.client].periods.push(w.period);
      }
    });
  });
}
