// ---------- Google Drive sync ----------
const GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID = '133028189439-gk1n4s8p044bauf7licohm22aadhsgcs.apps.googleusercontent.com';
const DRIVE_SCOPE = 'https://www.googleapis.com/auth/drive.appdata https://www.googleapis.com/auth/userinfo.email';
const DRIVE_FILENAME = 'leave-tracker-data.json';

let tokenClient = null;
let accessToken = null;
let driveFileId = null;
let signedIn = false;

function setSyncStatus(state, label){
  const dot = document.getElementById('syncDot');
  dot.className = 'sync-dot' + (state!=='idle' ? ' '+state : '');
  document.getElementById('syncLabel').textContent = label;
}

function updateSyncRowVisibility(){
  document.getElementById('syncRow').classList.toggle('connected', signedIn);
}
let signedInEmail = '';
async function fetchSignedInEmail(){
  try{
    const res = await fetch('https://www.googleapis.com/oauth2/v3/userinfo', { headers:{Authorization:'Bearer '+accessToken} });
    const data = await res.json();
    signedInEmail = data.email || '';
  }catch(e){ console.error('userinfo fetch error', e); signedInEmail = ''; }
}

function initGoogleAuth(){
  if(!window.google || !google.accounts || !google.accounts.oauth2){
    setTimeout(initGoogleAuth, 300);
    return;
  }
  tokenClient = google.accounts.oauth2.initTokenClient({
    client_id: GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID,
    scope: DRIVE_SCOPE,
    callback: async (resp)=>{
      if(resp.error){
        signedIn = false;
        updateSyncRowVisibility();
        setSyncStatus('error','Sign-in failed');
        showToast('Google sign-in failed \u2014 try again');
        return;
      }
      accessToken = resp.access_token;
      signedIn = true;
      updateSyncRowVisibility();
      const btn = document.getElementById('syncBtn');
      btn.textContent = 'Signed in';
      btn.classList.add('signed-in');
      setSyncStatus('syncing','Syncing with Drive...');
      await fetchSignedInEmail();
      await syncFromDrive();
      if(signedInEmail) document.getElementById('syncLabel').textContent = 'Synced \u2014 ' + signedInEmail;
    }
  });
  // No automatic sign-in attempt here \u2014 browsers (Safari especially) block OAuth
  // popups that aren't triggered by a direct tap, so an auto-attempt on page load just
  // flashes and fails. The visible "Sign in with Google" button is the real entry point.
}

async function driveFindFile(){
  const res = await fetch(`https://www.googleapis.com/drive/v3/files?spaces=appDataFolder&q=name%3D%27${DRIVE_FILENAME}%27&fields=files(id,name)`,{
    headers:{Authorization:'Bearer '+accessToken}
  });
  const data = await res.json();
  return (data.files && data.files.length) ? data.files[0].id : null;
}
async function driveCreateFile(content){
  const metadata = {name: DRIVE_FILENAME, parents:['appDataFolder']};
  const boundary = 'leavetrackerboundary';
  const body =
    `--${boundary}\r\nContent-Type: application/json; charset=UTF-8\r\n\r\n${JSON.stringify(metadata)}\r\n`+
    `--${boundary}\r\nContent-Type: application/json\r\n\r\n${content}\r\n`+
    `--${boundary}--`;
  const res = await fetch('https://www.googleapis.com/upload/drive/v3/files?uploadType=multipart&fields=id',{
    method:'POST',
    headers:{Authorization:'Bearer '+accessToken, 'Content-Type':`multipart/related; boundary=${boundary}`},
    body
  });
  const data = await res.json();
  return data.id;
}
async function driveReadFile(fileId){
  const res = await fetch(`https://www.googleapis.com/drive/v3/files/${fileId}?alt=media`,{
    headers:{Authorization:'Bearer '+accessToken}
  });
  return await res.text();
}
async function driveWriteFile(fileId, content){
  await fetch(`https://www.googleapis.com/upload/drive/v3/files/${fileId}?uploadType=media`,{
    method:'PATCH',
    headers:{Authorization:'Bearer '+accessToken, 'Content-Type':'application/json'},
    body: content
  });
}

// Merge two entry maps by keeping, per date, whichever side has the newer
// updatedAt timestamp (an entry with no timestamp at all \u2014 e.g. from the
// original Excel seed \u2014 counts as oldest, so any real save beats it).
// This replaces a plain "remote wins" overwrite, which is what used to wipe
// out days you'd just marked locally if they hadn't reached Drive yet.
function mergeEntries(local, remote){
  local = local||{}; remote = remote||{};
  const merged = {};
  new Set([...Object.keys(local), ...Object.keys(remote)]).forEach(k=>{
    const l = local[k], r = remote[k];
    if(l && r) merged[k] = (r.updatedAt||0) > (l.updatedAt||0) ? r : l;
    else merged[k] = l || r;
  });
  return merged;
}
// Union the two tombstone maps, keeping the newer deletion time per date.
function mergeDeleted(local, remote){
  local = local||{}; remote = remote||{};
  const merged = {...local};
  Object.keys(remote).forEach(k=>{ merged[k] = Math.max(merged[k]||0, remote[k]); });
  return merged;
}
// Apply tombstones after merging entries, so a day deleted on one device
// doesn't silently come back just because another device's copy is older.
function applyTombstones(entriesMap, tombstones){
  Object.keys(tombstones).forEach(ds=>{
    const e = entriesMap[ds];
    if(e && tombstones[ds] >= (e.updatedAt||0)) delete entriesMap[ds];
  });
  return entriesMap;
}
// Union client lists (registered clients + their audit periods) rather than
// letting one device's list replace the other's.
function mergeClients(local, remote){
  local = local||{}; remote = remote||{};
  const merged = {};
  new Set([...Object.keys(local), ...Object.keys(remote)]).forEach(name=>{
    const lp = (local[name]&&local[name].periods)||[];
    const rp = (remote[name]&&remote[name].periods)||[];
    merged[name] = { periods: [...new Set([...lp, ...rp])] };
  });
  return merged;
}

async function syncFromDrive(){
  try{
    let fileId = await driveFindFile();
    if(fileId){
      driveFileId = fileId;
      const text = await driveReadFile(fileId);
      const remote = JSON.parse(text || '{}');
      entries = mergeEntries(entries, remote.entries);
      deletedEntries = mergeDeleted(deletedEntries, remote.deleted);
      applyTombstones(entries, deletedEntries);
      if(remote.settings) settings = (remote.settings.updatedAt||0) > (settings.updatedAt||0) ? remote.settings : settings;
      clients = mergeClients(clients, remote.clients);
      if(settings.locked===undefined) settings.locked = true;
      Object.values(entries).forEach(e=>{ if(e.claimApproved===undefined) e.claimApproved=false; });
      const DEPT_MAP2 = {'Articles - Corporate':'Corporate','Articles - Audit':'Audit','Articles - Tax':'Tax','Articles - Advisory':'Advisory'};
      Object.values(entries).forEach(e=>{ if(DEPT_MAP2[e.dept]) e.dept = DEPT_MAP2[e.dept]; });
      if(!Object.keys(clients).length) bootstrapClientsFromEntries();
      migrateClientNames();
      localStorage.setItem('leave-tracker-entries-v1', JSON.stringify(entries));
      localStorage.setItem('leave-tracker-settings-v1', JSON.stringify(settings));
      localStorage.setItem('leave-tracker-clients-v1', JSON.stringify(clients));
      localStorage.setItem('leave-tracker-deleted-v1', JSON.stringify(deletedEntries));
    } else {
      driveFileId = await driveCreateFile(JSON.stringify({entries, settings, clients, deleted: deletedEntries}));
    }
    setSyncStatus('synced','Synced with Drive');
    pushToDrive(); // write the merged result straight back so Drive is caught up on this device's data too
    renderHeader(); populateDeptList(); populateClientSelects();
    const activeTab = document.querySelector('.tab-btn.active').dataset.tab;
    switchTab(activeTab);
  }catch(e){
    console.error('drive sync error', e);
    setSyncStatus('error','Sync failed \u2014 working offline');
  }
}

async function pushToDrive(retrying){
  if(!signedIn || !accessToken) return;
  try{
    setSyncStatus('syncing','Saving to Drive...');
    const payload = JSON.stringify({entries, settings, clients, deleted: deletedEntries});
    if(!driveFileId) driveFileId = await driveFindFile();
    if(driveFileId) await driveWriteFile(driveFileId, payload);
    else driveFileId = await driveCreateFile(payload);
    setSyncStatus('synced','Synced with Drive');
  }catch(e){
    console.error('drive push error', e);
    // Access tokens expire after about an hour and this app doesn't hold onto
    // them across reloads, so a stale token is the most common reason a push
    // fails silently. Try one silent refresh + retry before giving up.
    if(!retrying && tokenClient){
      try{
        await new Promise((resolve)=>{
          const prevCallback = tokenClient.callback;
          const timeout = setTimeout(()=>{ tokenClient.callback = prevCallback; resolve(); }, 5000);
          tokenClient.callback = (resp)=>{
            clearTimeout(timeout);
            tokenClient.callback = prevCallback;
            if(!resp.error){ accessToken = resp.access_token; }
            resolve();
          };
          tokenClient.requestAccessToken({prompt:''});
        });
        await pushToDrive(true);
        return;
      }catch(e2){ console.error('drive push retry error', e2); }
    }
    setSyncStatus('error','Could not sync \u2014 saved locally');
  }
}

// ---------- Header stats ----------
function renderHeader(){
  const u = usersDb[currentUserEmail];
  if(u){
    document.getElementById('userName').textContent = u.name || 'Trainee Account';
    document.getElementById('userFirm').innerHTML = escapeHtml(u.firm || 'Chartered Accountancy Firm') + ' &middot; Articleship (' + escapeHtml(u.email) + ')';
    const subBadge = document.getElementById('hdrSubBadge');
    const isAct = u.subscription && u.subscription.status === 'active';
    subBadge.className = 'sub-pill' + (isAct ? '' : ' expired');
    subBadge.innerHTML = isAct
      ? '&#9679; ' + escapeHtml(u.subscription.plan || 'Active Subscriber')
      : '&#9888; Subscription Expired &mdash; Tap Account &amp; Plan';
    document.getElementById('hdrArticleshipSpan').innerHTML =
      fmtDate(ARTICLESHIP_START) + ' &rarr; ' + fmtDate(ARTICLESHIP_END) + ' (3.5 yrs)';
  }
  const start = new Date(ARTICLESHIP_START+'T00:00:00');
  const end = new Date(ARTICLESHIP_END+'T00:00:00');
  const now = new Date();
  const totalDays = Math.max(1, Math.floor((end-start)/86400000)+1);
  const dayNum = Math.max(1, Math.floor((now-start)/86400000)+1);
  const daysLeft = Math.max(0, Math.floor((end-now)/86400000));
  document.getElementById('dayCount').textContent = dayNum+' / '+totalDays;
  document.getElementById('daysLeft').textContent = daysLeft.toLocaleString();
  const bal = computeBalance();
  document.getElementById('balMini').textContent = bal.finalBalance;
  document.getElementById('balChip').classList.toggle('warn', bal.finalBalance < 15);
}

// ---------- Balance calc (mirrors the original spreadsheet formula) ----------
// Note: Saturdays/Sundays/holidays worked only count toward the balance once
// they're approved as claimed on the Claims tab (claimApproved === true).
function getExamSessions(){
  const startY = parseInt((ARTICLESHIP_START||'2024-08-01').slice(0,4)) || 2024;
  const endY = parseInt((ARTICLESHIP_END||'2028-01-31').slice(0,4)) || 2028;
  const sessions = [];
  for(let y = startY; y <= endY; y++){
    sessions.push('Summer ' + y);
    sessions.push('Winter ' + y);
  }
  // Ensure any remark session already used in entries is also included
  Object.values(entries).forEach(e=>{
    if(e.remark && e.remark !== 'Others' && e.remark !== 'Saturday' && e.remark !== 'Sunday' && !sessions.includes(e.remark)){
      sessions.push(e.remark);
    }
  });
  return sessions;
}
function populateRemarkDropdowns(){
  const sessions = getExamSessions();
  const html = '<option value="">Select a category...</option><option>Others</option>' +
    sessions.map(s=>`<option value="${escapeHtml(s)}">${escapeHtml(s)}</option>`).join('');
  ['f-remark','lr-remark'].forEach(id=>{
    const el = document.getElementById(id);
    if(el){
      const cur = el.value;
      el.innerHTML = html;
      if(cur) el.value = cur;
    }
  });
}
function isWeekendOrHolidayWorked(e){
  return e.status==='Present' && (e.day==='Saturday' || e.day==='Sunday' || e.holidayWorked);
}
function computeBalance(){
  const list = Object.values(entries);
  const satWorked = list.filter(e=>e.day==='Saturday' && e.status==='Present' && e.claimApproved).length;
  const sunWorked = list.filter(e=>e.day==='Sunday' && e.status==='Present' && e.claimApproved).length;
  const phWorked = list.filter(e=>e.holidayWorked && e.status==='Present' && e.claimApproved).length;
  const examCounts = {};
  const remarkEligible = e => (e.status==='Leave' || e.status==='Absent');
  const activeSessions = getExamSessions();
  activeSessions.forEach(s=> examCounts[s] = list.filter(e=>remarkEligible(e) && e.remark===s).length);
  const examTotal = Object.values(examCounts).reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0);
  const othersCount = list.filter(e=>remarkEligible(e) && e.remark==='Others').length;
  const credit = settings.allowed + satWorked + sunWorked + phWorked;
  const afterExam = credit - examTotal;
  const leaveBalance = afterExam - othersCount;
  const finalBalance = leaveBalance + (settings.adjustment||0);
  return {satWorked,sunWorked,phWorked,examCounts,examTotal,othersCount,credit,leaveBalance,finalBalance};
}

function renderBalance(){
  const b = computeBalance();
  document.getElementById('balHeroNum').textContent = b.finalBalance;
  document.getElementById('b-allowed').textContent = settings.allowed;
  document.getElementById('b-sat').textContent = '+'+b.satWorked;
  document.getElementById('b-sun').textContent = '+'+b.sunWorked;
  document.getElementById('b-ph').textContent = '+'+b.phWorked;
  document.getElementById('b-exam').textContent = '\u2212'+b.examTotal;
  document.getElementById('b-others').textContent = '\u2212'+b.othersCount;
  document.getElementById('b-total').textContent = b.leaveBalance;
  document.getElementById('b-adj').value = settings.adjustment;
  document.getElementById('b-final').textContent = b.finalBalance;
  document.getElementById('s-allowed').value = settings.allowed;
  const pct = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, (b.finalBalance/settings.allowed)*100));
  document.getElementById('balProgress').style.width = pct+'%';

  const eb = document.getElementById('examBreakdown');
  eb.innerHTML = getExamSessions().map(s=>
    `<div class="bal-row sub"><span>${s}</span><span class="v">${b.examCounts[s]||0}</span></div>`
  ).join('');
}

// ---------- Today form ----------
function setStatus(s){
  currentStatus = s;
  document.querySelectorAll('#statusSeg button').forEach(b=>{
    b.classList.toggle('sel', b.dataset.s===s);
  });
  const needsRemark = (s==='Leave' || s==='Absent');
  document.getElementById('remarkGroup').style.display = needsRemark ? 'block' : 'none';
}
function applyFutureDateGuard(dateStr){
  const isFuture = dateStr > todayStr();
  document.querySelectorAll('#statusSeg button').forEach(b=>{
    const allowed = !isFuture || b.dataset.s==='Leave';
    b.disabled = !allowed;
    b.style.opacity = allowed ? '1' : '0.35';
    b.style.cursor = allowed ? 'pointer' : 'not-allowed';
  });
  if(isFuture && currentStatus!=='Leave'){ setStatus('Leave'); }
}
// Editing a day that's already been saved requires unlocking the register first;
// creating a brand-new day's entry is always allowed regardless of lock state.
function updateFormLockState(dateStr){
  const existing = entries[dateStr];
  const isLockedEdit = !!existing && settings.locked;
  document.getElementById('lockBanner').style.display = isLockedEdit ? 'block' : 'none';
  ['f-dept','f-holidayworked','f-remark','f-reason','saveBtn','addWorkBtn','deleteEntryBtn'].forEach(id=>{
    const el = document.getElementById(id);
    if(el) el.disabled = isLockedEdit;
  });
  if(isLockedEdit){
    document.querySelectorAll('#statusSeg button').forEach(b=>{ b.disabled = true; b.style.opacity='0.35'; b.style.cursor='not-allowed'; });
  }
  document.querySelectorAll('.work-row select, .work-row .rm').forEach(el=>{ el.disabled = isLockedEdit; });
}
function renderLockUI(){
  const row = document.getElementById('lockRow');
  const txt = document.getElementById('lockStatusText');
  const btn = document.getElementById('lockToggleBtn');
  if(settings.locked){
    row.classList.remove('unlocked');
    txt.innerHTML = '&#128274; Register locked';
    btn.textContent = 'Unlock to edit';
  } else {
    row.classList.add('unlocked');
    txt.innerHTML = '&#128275; Unlocked \u2014 re-locks after your next save';
    btn.textContent = 'Lock now';
  }
}
function renderTodayStatus(){
  const banner = document.getElementById('todayStatusBanner');
  const t = todayStr();
  const e = entries[t];
  if(e){
    banner.className = 'today-status marked';
    const labelMap = {'Present':'Present','Leave':'On Leave','Public Holiday':'Public Holiday','Absent':'Absent','WFH':'WFH','Half Day':'Half Day'};
    banner.innerHTML = `<span class="dot2"></span> Today's attendance is marked \u2014 ${labelMap[e.status]||e.status}`;
  } else {
    banner.className = 'today-status unmarked';
    banner.innerHTML = `<span class="dot2"></span> Today's attendance isn't marked yet`;
  }
}
// Returns client names allowed for the currently selected department on the Today
// tab, plus GT - Islamabad (always available since firm-based work can happen
// regardless of which department you're seconded to).
function getClientNamesForCurrentDept(){
  const deptEl = document.getElementById('f-dept');
  const dept = deptEl ? deptEl.value : '';
  return Object.keys(clients).filter(c=>{
    if(c === 'GT - Islamabad') return true;
    return (clients[c].dept || 'Audit') === dept;
  }).sort();
}
function addWorkRow(client, period, location){
  const id = 'wr'+(workRowCount++);
  const div = document.createElement('div');
  div.className = 'work-row';
  div.id = id;
  const isFirmRemote = location === 'Firm';
  const displayClient = isFirmRemote ? 'GT - Islamabad' : client;
  const clientNames = getClientNamesForCurrentDept();
  const clientOptions = clientNames.length
    ? '<option value="">Select client...</option>' + clientNames.map(c=>`<option value="${escapeHtml(c)}" ${c===displayClient?'selected':''}>${escapeHtml(c)}</option>`).join('')
    : '<option value="">No clients added yet</option>';
  div.innerHTML = `
    <select class="wr-client">${clientOptions}</select>
    <select class="wr-period"><option value="">Select period...</option></select>
    <button type="button" class="rm" onclick="document.getElementById('${id}').remove()">&times;</button>
    <div class="gt-firm-choice" style="display:none;">
      <div class="gt-firm-seg">
        <button type="button" data-choice="firm">General firm work</button>
        <button type="button" data-choice="client">Working a client's file</button>
      </div>
      <div class="gt-firm-client-wrap" style="display:none;">
        <select class="wr-realclient"></select>
        <select class="wr-realperiod"><option value="">Select period...</option></select>
      </div>
    </div>
  `;
  document.getElementById('workRows').appendChild(div);
  const clientSel = div.querySelector('.wr-client');
  const periodSel = div.querySelector('.wr-period');
  const gtWrap = div.querySelector('.gt-firm-choice');
  const segBtns = div.querySelectorAll('.gt-firm-seg button');
  const clientWrap = div.querySelector('.gt-firm-client-wrap');
  const realClientSel = div.querySelector('.wr-realclient');
  const realPeriodSel = div.querySelector('.wr-realperiod');
  function refreshPeriods(selectedPeriod){
    const c = clientSel.value;
    const periods = (clients[c] && clients[c].periods) || [];
    periodSel.innerHTML = periods.length
      ? '<option value="">Select period...</option>' + periods.map(p=>`<option value="${escapeHtml(p)}" ${p===selectedPeriod?'selected':''}>${escapeHtml(p)}</option>`).join('')
      : '<option value="">No periods added for this client</option>';
  }
  // GT - Islamabad's own "client from firm" sub-picker deliberately ignores the
  // department filter \u2014 while physically at the firm you might be covering any
  // client's file, not just ones in your currently-selected department.
  function buildRealClientOptions(selected){
    const names = Object.keys(clients).filter(c=>c!=='GT - Islamabad').sort();
    realClientSel.innerHTML = names.length
      ? '<option value="">Select client...</option>' + names.map(c=>`<option value="${escapeHtml(c)}" ${c===selected?'selected':''}>${escapeHtml(c)}</option>`).join('')
      : '<option value="">No clients added yet</option>';
  }
  function refreshRealPeriods(selectedPeriod){
    const c = realClientSel.value;
    const periods = (clients[c] && clients[c].periods) || [];
    realPeriodSel.innerHTML = periods.length
      ? '<option value="">Select period...</option>' + periods.map(p=>`<option value="${escapeHtml(p)}" ${p===selectedPeriod?'selected':''}>${escapeHtml(p)}</option>`).join('')
      : '<option value="">No periods added</option>';
  }
  function setFirmChoice(choice){
    segBtns.forEach(b=>b.classList.toggle('sel', b.dataset.choice===choice));
    clientWrap.style.display = choice==='client' ? 'block' : 'none';
  }
  function updateGtVisibility(){
    gtWrap.style.display = (clientSel.value === 'GT - Islamabad') ? 'block' : 'none';
  }
  refreshPeriods(period);
  buildRealClientOptions(isFirmRemote ? client : '');
  refreshRealPeriods(isFirmRemote ? period : '');
  setFirmChoice(isFirmRemote ? 'client' : 'firm');
  updateGtVisibility();
  clientSel.addEventListener('change', ()=>{
    refreshPeriods(null);
    if(clientSel.value === 'GT - Islamabad'){
      setFirmChoice('firm');
      buildRealClientOptions('');
      refreshRealPeriods('');
    }
    updateGtVisibility();
  });
  segBtns.forEach(b=>b.addEventListener('click', ()=>setFirmChoice(b.dataset.choice)));
  realClientSel.addEventListener('change', ()=>refreshRealPeriods(null));
}
function escapeHtml(s){ const d=document.createElement('div'); d.textContent=s; return d.innerHTML; }

function resetTodayForm(dateStr){
  document.getElementById('f-date').value = dateStr;
  const existing = entries[dateStr];
  document.getElementById('workRows').innerHTML = '';
  if(existing){
    setStatus(existing.status||'Present');
    document.getElementById('f-holidayworked').checked = !!existing.holidayWorked;
    document.getElementById('f-dept').value = existing.dept||'Corporate';
    document.getElementById('f-remark').value = existing.remark||'';
    document.getElementById('f-reason').value = existing.reason||'';
    if(existing.work && existing.work.length){
      existing.work.forEach(w=>addWorkRow(w.client,w.period,w.location));
    } else {
      addWorkRow('','');
    }
  } else {
    setStatus('Present');
    document.getElementById('f-holidayworked').checked = false;
    // carry over last used department as a convenience default
    const allDates = Object.keys(entries).sort();
    const lastDept = allDates.length ? entries[allDates[allDates.length-1]].dept : '';
    document.getElementById('f-dept').value = lastDept || 'Corporate';
    document.getElementById('f-remark').value = '';
    document.getElementById('f-reason').value = '';
    addWorkRow('','');
  }
  document.getElementById('deleteEntryBtn').style.display = existing ? 'block' : 'none';
  applyFutureDateGuard(dateStr);
  updateFormLockState(dateStr);
}

async function saveToday(){
  const u = usersDb[currentUserEmail];
  if(u && u.subscription && u.subscription.status !== 'active'){
    showToast('Your subscription has expired \u2014 renew in Account & Plan to record attendance');
    openProfileModal();
    return;
  }
  const dateStr = document.getElementById('f-date').value;
  if(!dateStr){ showToast('Pick a date first'); return; }
  if(entries[dateStr] && settings.locked){
    showToast('This day is already recorded \u2014 unlock the register first to change it');
    return;
  }
  if(dateStr > todayStr() && currentStatus !== 'Leave'){
    showToast('Future dates can only be marked as Leave (a pre-approved application) \u2014 not ' + currentStatus);
    return;
  }
  const needsRemark = (currentStatus==='Leave' || currentStatus==='Absent');
  const remarkVal = document.getElementById('f-remark').value;
  if(needsRemark && !remarkVal){
    showToast('Pick a remark category before saving a ' + currentStatus + ' day');
    return;
  }
  const work = [];
  document.querySelectorAll('.work-row').forEach(row=>{
    const client = row.querySelector('.wr-client').value.trim();
    const period = row.querySelector('.wr-period').value.trim();
    if(!client) return;
    if(client === 'GT - Islamabad'){
      const selBtn = row.querySelector('.gt-firm-seg button.sel');
      const choice = selBtn ? selBtn.dataset.choice : 'firm';
      if(choice === 'client'){
        const realClient = row.querySelector('.wr-realclient').value.trim();
        const realPeriod = row.querySelector('.wr-realperiod').value.trim();
        if(realClient){
          work.push({client: realClient, period: realPeriod||null, location:'Firm'});
          return;
        }
        // "Working a client's file" was selected but no client was actually picked —
        // fall through and log it as plain firm work instead of silently dropping the day.
      }
    }
    work.push({client, period: period||null});
  });
  const prevApproval = entries[dateStr] ? !!entries[dateStr].claimApproved : false;
  const entry = {
    date: dateStr,
    day: dayName(dateStr),
    status: currentStatus,
    dept: document.getElementById('f-dept').value.trim(),
    holidayWorked: document.getElementById('f-holidayworked').checked,
    work,
    remark: needsRemark ? remarkVal : '',
    reason: needsRemark ? document.getElementById('f-reason').value.trim() : '',
    claimApproved: prevApproval,
    updatedAt: Date.now()
  };
  entries[dateStr] = entry;
  settings.locked = true; // auto re-lock after every save
  await persistEntries();
  await persistSettings();
  renderHeader();
  populateDeptList();
  populateClientSelects();
  renderLockUI();
  renderTodayStatus();
  updateFormLockState(dateStr);

  // stamp animation
  const labelMap = {'Present':'Present','Leave':'On Leave','Public Holiday':'Holiday','Absent':'Absent','WFH':'WFH','Half Day':'Half Day'};
  document.getElementById('stampTxt1').textContent = labelMap[currentStatus]||currentStatus;
  document.getElementById('stampTxt2').textContent = fmtDate(dateStr);
  const overlay = document.getElementById('stampOverlay');
  overlay.classList.add('show');
  setTimeout(()=>overlay.classList.remove('show'), 1100);
}

// ---------- Log ----------
function openEdit(dateStr){
  switchTab('today');
  resetTodayForm(dateStr);
  window.scrollTo({top:0,behavior:'smooth'});
}

// ---------- Calendar (Log tab) \u2014 continuous scroll, all months of the articleship ----------
let calendarBuilt = false;
function renderMonthBlock(y, m){
  const label = new Date(y,m,1).toLocaleDateString('en-US',{month:'long',year:'numeric'});
  // Week starts Monday: getDay() is 0=Sun..6=Sat, so remap to 0=Mon..6=Sun.
  const firstDow = (new Date(y,m,1).getDay() + 6) % 7;
  const daysInMonth = new Date(y,m+1,0).getDate();
  const t = todayStr();
  let cells = '';
  for(let i=0;i<firstDow;i++) cells += '<div class="cal-day empty"></div>';
  for(let d=1; d<=daysInMonth; d++){
    const ds = y+'-'+String(m+1).padStart(2,'0')+'-'+String(d).padStart(2,'0');
    const e = entries[ds];
    const statusClass = e ? (e.holidayWorked ? 'HolidayWorked' : (e.status||'').replace(/\s+/g,'')) : '';
    const classes = ['cal-day'];
    if(e){ classes.push('has-entry', statusClass); }
    if(ds===t) classes.push('today');
    cells += `<div class="${classes.join(' ')}" data-date="${ds}">${d}</div>`;
  }
  // Pad the trailing end of the final week to a full 7 columns so the grid
  // always lays out in complete rows of 7, regardless of month length.
  const totalCells = firstDow + daysInMonth;
  const trailing = (7 - (totalCells % 7)) % 7;
  for(let i=0;i<trailing;i++) cells += '<div class="cal-day empty"></div>';
  return `<div class="cal-month-block" data-ym="${y}-${String(m+1).padStart(2,'0')}">
    <div class="cal-month-label">${label}</div>
    <div class="cal-weekdays"><span>M</span><span>T</span><span>W</span><span>T</span><span>F</span><span>S</span><span>S</span></div>
    <div class="cal-grid">${cells}</div>
  </div>`;
}
function renderCalendar(){
  const start = new Date(ARTICLESHIP_START+'T00:00:00');
  const end = new Date(ARTICLESHIP_END+'T00:00:00');
  let y = start.getFullYear(), m = start.getMonth();
  const endY = end.getFullYear(), endM = end.getMonth();
  let html = '';
  while(y < endY || (y===endY && m<=endM)){
    html += renderMonthBlock(y, m);
    m++; if(m>11){ m=0; y++; }
  }
  document.getElementById('calScroll').innerHTML = html;
}
function openDayDetail(dateStr){
  const e = entries[dateStr];
  if(!e) return;
  const labelMap = {'Present':'Present','Leave':'On Leave','Public Holiday':'Public Holiday','Absent':'Absent','WFH':'WFH','Half Day':'Half Day'};
  const workChips = (e.work||[]).map(w=>`<span class="chip">${escapeHtml(w.client)}${w.period?' &middot; '+escapeHtml(w.period):''}${w.location==='Firm'?' &middot; Remote (Firm)':''}</span>`).join('') || '<span style="color:var(--ink-soft);font-size:12.5px;">No client logged</span>';
  document.querySelector('#editModalBg .modal-hd h3').textContent = fmtDate(dateStr) + ' \u00b7 ' + e.day;
  document.getElementById('editModalBody').innerHTML = `
    <div class="day-detail">
      <div class="dd-row"><span class="dd-label">Attendance</span><span class="dd-val">${labelMap[e.status]||e.status}${e.holidayWorked?' <span style="color:var(--worked);font-weight:700;">(Worked)</span>':''}</span></div>
      <div class="dd-row"><span class="dd-label">Department</span><span class="dd-val">${escapeHtml(e.dept||'\u2014')}</span></div>
      <div class="dd-row"><span class="dd-label">Client(s)</span><div class="dd-chips">${workChips}</div></div>
      ${e.remark?`<div class="dd-row"><span class="dd-label">Remark</span><span class="dd-val">${escapeHtml(e.remark)}</span></div>`:''}
      ${e.reason?`<div class="dd-row"><span class="dd-label">Note</span><span class="dd-val">${escapeHtml(e.reason)}</span></div>`:''}
      ${(e.day==='Saturday'||e.day==='Sunday'||e.holidayWorked) && e.status==='Present' ? `<div class="dd-row"><span class="dd-label">Firm claim</span><span class="dd-val">${e.claimApproved?'Approved':'Pending approval'}</span></div>` : ''}
      <button type="button" class="btn-primary" id="editDayBtn">Edit this day</button>
      <button type="button" class="btn-secondary" id="deleteDayBtn" style="margin-top:8px;width:100%;background:none;border-color:var(--absent);color:var(--absent);">Delete this entry</button>
    </div>
  `;
  document.getElementById('editDayBtn').addEventListener('click', ()=>{ closeDayModal(); openEdit(dateStr); });
  document.getElementById('deleteDayBtn').addEventListener('click', ()=>{ deleteEntryWithConfirm(dateStr); });
  document.getElementById('editModalBg').classList.add('show');
}
function closeDayModal(){
  document.getElementById('editModalBg').classList.remove('show');
}
// Shared by the calendar's delete button and the Today tab's delete button.
// Locked days can't be deleted any more than they can be edited \u2014 same protection.
function deleteEntryWithConfirm(dateStr){
  if(!entries[dateStr]) return;
  if(settings.locked){ showToast('Unlock the register first to delete this entry'); return; }
  pendingDeleteDateStr = dateStr;
  document.getElementById('confirmDeleteText').textContent = `Are you sure you want to delete the attendance record for ${fmtDate(dateStr)}? This action cannot be undone.`;
  document.getElementById('confirmDeleteModalBg').classList.add('show');
}

async function executeConfirmedDelete(){
  const dateStr = pendingDeleteDateStr;
  document.getElementById('confirmDeleteModalBg').classList.remove('show');
  pendingDeleteDateStr = null;
  if(!dateStr || !entries[dateStr]) return;
  delete entries[dateStr];
  deletedEntries[dateStr] = Date.now();
  await persistEntries();
  await persistDeleted();
  renderHeader();
  renderTodayStatus();
  closeDayModal();
  renderCalendar();
  if(document.getElementById('f-date').value === dateStr) resetTodayForm(dateStr);
  showToast('Entry deleted for ' + fmtDate(dateStr));
}
function renderLog(){
  renderCalendar(); // always refresh so newly saved/deleted days show up immediately
  if(!calendarBuilt){
    calendarBuilt = true;
    const ym = todayStr().slice(0,7);
    const block = document.querySelector(`.cal-month-block[data-ym="${ym}"]`);
    if(block && block.scrollIntoView) block.scrollIntoView({block:'start'});
  }
}

// ---------- Client registry (add-client-first workflow) ----------
function populateDeptList(){ /* no-op: department is now a fixed dropdown */ }
// Refreshes any client <select> currently on screen (kept name distinct from the
// registry-add helpers below since work-row selects are rebuilt on demand instead).
function populateClientSelects(){ /* no-op placeholder: work rows rebuild their own options via addWorkRow */ }

async function addClient(name, period, dept){
  name = name.trim();
  if(!name) return;
  if(clients[name]){ showToast('That client is already added'); return; }
  clients[name] = { periods: [], dept: (dept && dept.trim()) || 'Audit' };
  if(period && period.trim()) clients[name].periods.push(period.trim());
  await persistClients();
  renderRegistry();
  refreshWorkRowClientOptions();
  showToast(`Added ${name}`);
}
async function addPeriod(clientName, period){
  period = period.trim();
  if(!period || !clients[clientName]) return;
  if(clients[clientName].periods.includes(period)){ showToast('That period is already added'); return; }
  clients[clientName].periods.push(period);
  await persistClients();
  renderRegistry();
  refreshWorkRowPeriodOptions(clientName);
}
async function removePeriod(clientName, period){
  if(!clients[clientName]) return;
  clients[clientName].periods = clients[clientName].periods.filter(p=>p!==period);
  await persistClients();
  renderRegistry();
  refreshWorkRowPeriodOptions(clientName);
}
// Keeps any work-row selects already on screen in sync after the registry changes,
// so you don't have to reload/reset the Today form to see a client or period you just added.
function refreshWorkRowClientOptions(){
  document.querySelectorAll('.work-row').forEach(row=>{
    const sel = row.querySelector('.wr-client');
    const cur = sel.value;
    const clientNames = getClientNamesForCurrentDept();
    sel.innerHTML = clientNames.length
      ? '<option value="">Select client...</option>' + clientNames.map(c=>`<option value="${escapeHtml(c)}" ${c===cur?'selected':''}>${escapeHtml(c)}</option>`).join('')
      : '<option value="">No clients added yet</option>';
  });
}
function refreshWorkRowPeriodOptions(clientName){
  document.querySelectorAll('.work-row').forEach(row=>{
    const clientSel = row.querySelector('.wr-client');
    if(clientSel.value !== clientName) return;
    const periodSel = row.querySelector('.wr-period');
    const cur = periodSel.value;
    const periods = (clients[clientName] && clients[clientName].periods) || [];
    periodSel.innerHTML = periods.length
      ? '<option value="">Select period...</option>' + periods.map(p=>`<option value="${escapeHtml(p)}" ${p===cur?'selected':''}>${escapeHtml(p)}</option>`).join('')
      : '<option value="">No periods added for this client</option>';
  });
}

const DEPT_OPTIONS = ['Corporate','Audit','Tax','Advisory','Secondment'];
function renderRegistry(){
  const container = document.getElementById('clientsRegistryList');
  const names = Object.keys(clients).sort();
  if(!names.length){
    container.innerHTML = '<div class="registry-empty">No clients added yet \u2014 add one above.</div>';
    return;
  }
  container.innerHTML = names.map(n=>{
    const periods = clients[n].periods;
    const periodPills = periods.map(p=>
      `<span class="period-pill">${escapeHtml(p)}<button type="button" data-client="${escapeHtml(n)}" data-period="${escapeHtml(p)}" class="rm-period">&times;</button></span>`
    ).join('') || '<span style="font-size:12px;color:var(--ink-soft);">No periods yet</span>';
    const isFirm = n === 'GT - Islamabad';
    const deptControl = isFirm
      ? '<span style="font-size:11.5px;color:var(--ink-soft);">Always available in every department</span>'
      : `<select class="dept-select" data-client="${escapeHtml(n)}" style="width:auto;display:inline-block;padding:5px 8px;font-size:12px;">${DEPT_OPTIONS.map(d=>`<option value="${d}" ${((clients[n].dept||'Audit')===d)?'selected':''}>${d}</option>`).join('')}</select>`;
    return `<div class="registry-card" data-client-card="${escapeHtml(n)}">
      <div class="rname-row">
        <span class="rname-text">${escapeHtml(n)}</span>
        <button type="button" class="btn-secondary rename-btn" data-client="${escapeHtml(n)}">Rename</button>
      </div>
      <div style="margin-top:6px;">${deptControl}</div>
      <div class="period-list">${periodPills}</div>
      <div class="add-period-row">
        <input type="text" class="new-period-input" placeholder="e.g. Jun 30, 2025" data-client="${escapeHtml(n)}">
        <button type="button" class="btn-secondary add-period-btn" data-client="${escapeHtml(n)}">Add period</button>
      </div>
    </div>`;
  }).join('');
  container.querySelectorAll('.rm-period').forEach(btn=>{
    btn.addEventListener('click', ()=>removePeriod(btn.dataset.client, btn.dataset.period));
  });
  container.querySelectorAll('.add-period-btn').forEach(btn=>{
    btn.addEventListener('click', ()=>{
      const input = container.querySelector(`.new-period-input[data-client="${CSS.escape(btn.dataset.client)}"]`);
      addPeriod(btn.dataset.client, input.value);
      input.value='';
    });
  });
  container.querySelectorAll('.rename-btn').forEach(btn=>{
    btn.addEventListener('click', ()=>startRenameClient(btn.dataset.client));
  });
  container.querySelectorAll('.dept-select').forEach(sel=>{
    sel.addEventListener('change', async ()=>{
      const name = sel.dataset.client;
      if(!clients[name]) return;
      clients[name].dept = sel.value;
      await persistClients();
      refreshWorkRowClientOptions();
      showToast(`${name} moved to ${sel.value}`);
    });
  });
}

function startRenameClient(clientName){
  const card = document.querySelector(`.registry-card[data-client-card="${CSS.escape(clientName)}"]`);
  const row = card.querySelector('.rname-row');
  row.innerHTML = `
    <input type="text" class="rename-input" value="${escapeHtml(clientName)}" style="flex:1;padding:7px 9px;font-size:13.5px;">
    <button type="button" class="btn-secondary rename-save" style="margin-left:6px;">Save</button>
    <button type="button" class="btn-secondary rename-cancel" style="margin-left:4px;">Cancel</button>
  `;
  row.style.display = 'flex';
  row.style.gap = '4px';
  const input = row.querySelector('.rename-input');
  input.focus();
  input.select();
  row.querySelector('.rename-save').addEventListener('click', ()=>renameClient(clientName, input.value));
  row.querySelector('.rename-cancel').addEventListener('click', renderRegistry);
  input.addEventListener('keydown', (e)=>{
    if(e.key==='Enter') renameClient(clientName, input.value);
    if(e.key==='Escape') renderRegistry();
  });
}

// Renaming to a name that already exists merges the two clients: periods are
// combined (duplicates dropped) and every logged day pointing at the old name
// gets repointed to the surviving name \u2014 so consolidating "Pak China - June 2025"
// and "Pak China" into one client with two periods doesn't create a duplicate.
async function renameClient(oldName, newNameRaw){
  const newName = newNameRaw.trim();
  if(!newName || !clients[oldName]){ renderRegistry(); return; }
  if(newName === oldName){ renderRegistry(); return; }
  const existingKey = Object.keys(clients).find(k=>k.toLowerCase()===newName.toLowerCase() && k!==oldName);
  if(existingKey){
    const merged = new Set([...(clients[existingKey].periods||[]), ...(clients[oldName].periods||[])]);
    clients[existingKey].periods = [...merged];
    delete clients[oldName];
    Object.values(entries).forEach(e=>{
      (e.work||[]).forEach(w=>{ if(w.client===oldName) w.client = existingKey; });
    });
    await persistClients();
    await persistEntries();
    showToast(`Merged "${oldName}" into "${existingKey}"`);
  } else {
    clients[newName] = clients[oldName];
    delete clients[oldName];
    Object.values(entries).forEach(e=>{
      (e.work||[]).forEach(w=>{ if(w.client===oldName) w.client = newName; });
    });
    await persistClients();
    await persistEntries();
    showToast(`Renamed to "${newName}"`);
  }
  renderRegistry();
  refreshWorkRowClientOptions();
  if(document.getElementById('tab-clients').style.display!=='none') renderClients();
}

// ---------- Time-spent pie chart (Clients tab) ----------
const PIE_PALETTE = ['#8B2E2E','#2F6B3E','#B8860B','#5B4B8A','#4A5568','#C4756B','#3C6E47','#A67C00','#7C6BA6','#8A97A8','#6B8CA6','#9A6B4A'];
let pieView = 'dept'; // 'dept' or 'client'
const WORKING_STATUSES = ['Present','WFH','Half Day'];
function computeDeptBreakdown(){
  const counts = {};
  Object.values(entries).forEach(e=>{
    if(WORKING_STATUSES.includes(e.status)){
      const d = e.dept || 'Unspecified';
      counts[d] = (counts[d]||0)+1;
    }
  });
  return counts;
}
function computeClientBreakdown(){
  const counts = {};
  Object.values(entries).forEach(e=>{
    if(WORKING_STATUSES.includes(e.status)){
      if(e.work && e.work.length){
        e.work.forEach(w=>{ counts[w.client] = (counts[w.client]||0)+1; });
      } else {
        counts['Unspecified'] = (counts['Unspecified']||0)+1;
      }
    } else {
      counts['Off (Leave / Holiday / Absent)'] = (counts['Off (Leave / Holiday / Absent)']||0)+1;
    }
  });
  return counts;
}
function renderPieChart(){
  const counts = pieView==='dept' ? computeDeptBreakdown() : computeClientBreakdown();
  const entriesArr = Object.entries(counts).sort((a,b)=>b[1]-a[1]);
  const total = entriesArr.reduce((a,[,v])=>a+v,0);
  const pieEl = document.getElementById('pieChart');
  const legendEl = document.getElementById('pieLegend');
  document.getElementById('pieViewLabel').textContent = pieView==='dept' ? 'By department (tap to switch)' : 'By client (tap to switch)';
  if(!total){
    pieEl.style.background = 'var(--line-soft)';
    legendEl.innerHTML = '<div class="registry-empty">No days logged yet</div>';
    return;
  }
  let acc = 0;
  const stops = entriesArr.map(([label,val],i)=>{
    const startPct = (acc/total)*100;
    acc += val;
    const endPct = (acc/total)*100;
    return `${PIE_PALETTE[i%PIE_PALETTE.length]} ${startPct}% ${endPct}%`;
  });
  pieEl.style.background = `conic-gradient(${stops.join(', ')})`;
  legendEl.innerHTML = entriesArr.map(([label,val],i)=>{
    const pct = ((val/total)*100).toFixed(1);
    return `<div class="pie-legend-row"><i class="pie-dot" style="background:${PIE_PALETTE[i%PIE_PALETTE.length]}"></i><span class="pl-label">${escapeHtml(label)}</span><span class="pl-val">${val}d \u00b7 ${pct}%</span></div>`;
  }).join('');
}

function renderClients(){
  renderRegistry();
  renderPieChart();
}

// ---------- Claims (weekend/holiday worked \u2014 pending firm approval) ----------
function renderClaims(){
  const dates = Object.keys(entries).filter(d=>isWeekendOrHolidayWorked(entries[d])).sort().reverse();
  const pending = dates.filter(d=>!entries[d].claimApproved);
  const approved = dates.filter(d=>entries[d].claimApproved);
  document.getElementById('claimsPendingCount').textContent = pending.length;
  document.getElementById('claimsApprovedCount').textContent = approved.length;

  const list = document.getElementById('claimsList');
  if(!dates.length){
    list.innerHTML = '<div class="empty"><div class="big">No weekend or holiday work logged yet</div>Days you mark Present on a Saturday, Sunday, or a public holiday show up here for firm approval.</div>';
    return;
  }
  list.innerHTML = dates.map(d=>{
    const e = entries[d];
    const tag = e.holidayWorked && e.day!=='Saturday' && e.day!=='Sunday' ? 'Holiday' : e.day;
    const workStr = (e.work||[]).map(w=>w.client+(w.period?' \u2014 '+w.period:'')).join(', ') || 'No client logged';
    return `<div class="claim-row" data-date="${d}">
      <div class="cr-top"><span class="cr-date">${fmtDate(d)}</span><span class="cr-tag ${tag.replace(/\s+/g,'')}">${tag}</span></div>
      <div class="cr-meta">${escapeHtml(workStr)}</div>
      <div class="cr-actions">
        <span class="claim-badge ${e.claimApproved?'approved':'pending'}">${e.claimApproved?'Approved by firm':'Pending approval'}</span>
        <button type="button" class="claim-toggle ${e.claimApproved?'unapprove':'approve'}" data-date="${d}">${e.claimApproved?'Unapprove':'Mark approved'}</button>
      </div>
    </div>`;
  }).join('');
  list.querySelectorAll('.claim-toggle').forEach(btn=>{
    btn.addEventListener('click', async ()=>{
      const d = btn.dataset.date;
      entries[d].claimApproved = !entries[d].claimApproved;
      await persistEntries();
      renderClaims();
      renderHeader();
      showToast(entries[d].claimApproved ? 'Marked approved \u2014 added to balance' : 'Marked pending');
    });
  });
}

function renderInstallBanner(){

  const banner = document.getElementById('installBanner');

// ---------- Backup & merge (for reconciling data across different Google accounts) ----------
function exportData(){
  const payload = { entries, clients, settings, exportedAt: new Date().toISOString() };
  const blob = new Blob([JSON.stringify(payload, null, 2)], {type:'application/json'});
  const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  const a = document.createElement('a');
  a.href = url;
  a.download = `leave-tracker-backup-${todayStr()}.json`;
  document.body.appendChild(a);
  a.click();
  document.body.removeChild(a);
  URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
  showToast('Backup downloaded');
}
// Additive merge only: a day already recorded on this device is never overwritten by
// the imported file \u2014 only days missing here get added in. Client periods are unioned.
async function importAndMerge(file){
  if(!file){ showToast('Choose a backup file first'); return; }
  try{
    const text = await file.text();
    const data = JSON.parse(text);
    let addedEntries = 0, skippedEntries = 0, addedClients = 0;
    if(data.entries){
      Object.entries(data.entries).forEach(([date, e])=>{
        if(!entries[date]){ entries[date] = e; addedEntries++; }
        else { skippedEntries++; }
      });
    }
    if(data.clients){
      Object.entries(data.clients).forEach(([name, c])=>{
        if(!clients[name]){ clients[name] = c; addedClients++; }
        else { (c.periods||[]).forEach(p=>{ if(!clients[name].periods.includes(p)) clients[name].periods.push(p); }); }
      });
    }
    migrateClientDepartments(); // newly-merged clients get a default department right away, not just after reload
    await persistEntries();
    await persistClients();
    renderHeader(); renderTodayStatus();
    ['log','balance','clients'].forEach(t=>{ if(document.getElementById('tab-'+t).style.display!=='none'){
      if(t==='log') renderLog(); if(t==='balance') renderBalance(); if(t==='clients') renderClients();
    }});
    showToast(`Merged: +${addedEntries} day(s) added, ${skippedEntries} already existed, +${addedClients} new client(s)`);
  }catch(e){
    console.error('import error', e);
    showToast("Could not read that file \u2014 make sure it's a backup exported from this app");
  }
}

// ---------- Lock toggle & date-range leave tool ----------
async function toggleLock(){
  settings.locked = !settings.locked;
  await persistSettings();
  renderLockUI();
  renderTodayStatus();
  updateFormLockState(document.getElementById('f-date').value);
  showToast(settings.locked ? 'Register locked' : 'Register unlocked \u2014 remember it re-locks after your next save');
}

async function markLeaveRange(){
  const u = usersDb[currentUserEmail];
  if(u && u.subscription && u.subscription.status !== 'active'){
    showToast('Your subscription has expired \u2014 renew in Account & Plan to record attendance');
    openProfileModal();
    return;
  }
  const start = document.getElementById('lr-start').value;
  const end = document.getElementById('lr-end').value;
  const remark = document.getElementById('lr-remark').value;
  const dept = document.getElementById('lr-dept').value;
  const reason = document.getElementById('lr-reason').value.trim();
  if(!start || !end){ showToast('Pick both a start and end date'); return; }
  if(end < start){ showToast('End date must be on or after the start date'); return; }
  if(!remark){ showToast('Pick a remark category for this leave'); return; }

  let cursor = new Date(start+'T00:00:00');
  const endD = new Date(end+'T00:00:00');
  let created = 0, skippedLocked = 0;
  while(cursor <= endD){
    const ds = cursor.getFullYear()+'-'+String(cursor.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,'0')+'-'+String(cursor.getDate()).padStart(2,'0');
    const existing = entries[ds];
    if(existing && settings.locked){
      skippedLocked++;
    } else {
      entries[ds] = {
        date: ds, day: dayName(ds), status: 'Leave', dept: dept,
        holidayWorked: false, work: [], remark: remark, reason: reason,
        claimApproved: existing ? !!existing.claimApproved : false,
        updatedAt: Date.now()
      };
      created++;
    }
    cursor.setDate(cursor.getDate()+1);
  }
  settings.locked = true;
  await persistEntries();
  await persistSettings();
  renderHeader();
  renderBalance();
  renderLockUI();
  renderTodayStatus();
  document.getElementById('lr-start').value = '';
  document.getElementById('lr-end').value = '';
  document.getElementById('lr-reason').value = '';
  document.getElementById('lr-remark').value = '';
  let msg = `Marked ${created} day(s) as Leave`;
  if(skippedLocked) msg += ` \u2014 skipped ${skippedLocked} already-recorded day(s) (register was locked)`;
  showToast(msg);
}

// ---------- Swipe between tabs ----------
const TAB_ORDER = ['today','log','balance','claims','clients'];
let touchStartX = 0, touchStartY = 0;
function initSwipeNav(){
  document.addEventListener('touchstart', (e)=>{
    if(e.touches.length!==1) return;
    touchStartX = e.touches[0].clientX;
    touchStartY = e.touches[0].clientY;
  }, {passive:true});
  document.addEventListener('touchend', (e)=>{
    if(document.querySelector('.modal-bg.show')) return; // don't switch tabs behind an open modal
    const touch = e.changedTouches[0];
    const dx = touch.clientX - touchStartX;
    const dy = touch.clientY - touchStartY;
    // Require a clearly horizontal, deliberate swipe so vertical scrolling
    // (the calendar especially) never gets mistaken for a tab change.
    if(Math.abs(dx) > 70 && Math.abs(dx) > Math.abs(dy)*1.5){
      const current = document.querySelector('.tab-btn.active').dataset.tab;
      const idx = TAB_ORDER.indexOf(current);
      if(dx < 0 && idx < TAB_ORDER.length-1) switchTab(TAB_ORDER[idx+1]); // swipe left \u2192 next tab
      else if(dx > 0 && idx > 0) switchTab(TAB_ORDER[idx-1]); // swipe right \u2192 previous tab
    }
  }, {passive:true});
}


// ---------- Multi-User Auth, 3.5-Year Timeline & Subscription Management ----------
function updateSignupTimelinePreview(){
  const startVal = document.getElementById('suStartDate').value;
  const startEl = document.getElementById('suPreviewStart');
  const endEl = document.getElementById('suPreviewEnd');
  const daysEl = document.getElementById('suPreviewDays');
  if(!startVal){
    startEl.textContent = '\u2014';
    endEl.textContent = '\u2014';
    daysEl.textContent = '\u2014';
    return;
  }
  const endVal = calculateArticleshipEndDate(startVal);
  const sDate = new Date(startVal+'T00:00:00');
  const eDate = new Date(endVal+'T00:00:00');
  const totalDays = Math.floor((eDate - sDate)/86400000) + 1;
  startEl.textContent = fmtDate(startVal);
  endEl.textContent = fmtDate(endVal);
  daysEl.textContent = totalDays.toLocaleString() + ' days (3.5 Years)';
}

function renderSavedAccountsList(){
  const container = document.getElementById('savedAccountsList');
  if(!container) return;
  const list = Object.values(usersDb);
  container.innerHTML = list.map(u=>{
    const endStr = u.articleshipEnd || calculateArticleshipEndDate(u.articleshipStart);
    const clientCount = Object.keys(u.clients||{}).length;
    return `<button type="button" class="demo-chip" data-login-email="${escapeHtml(u.email)}">
      <div class="dc-name">${escapeHtml(u.name)}</div>
      <div class="dc-meta">${escapeHtml(u.email)}</div>
      <div class="dc-meta">${fmtDate(u.articleshipStart)} &rarr; ${fmtDate(endStr)} &middot; ${clientCount} client(s)</div>
    </button>`;
  }).join('');
  container.querySelectorAll('.demo-chip').forEach(btn=>{
    btn.addEventListener('click', ()=>{
      const email = btn.dataset.loginEmail;
      if(usersDb[email]){
        completeUserLogin(email);
      }
    });
  });
}

function showAuthScreen(mode){
  renderSavedAccountsList();
  document.getElementById('authScreen').classList.add('show');
  switchAuthTab(mode || 'login');
}

function hideAuthScreen(){
  document.getElementById('authScreen').classList.remove('show');
}

function switchAuthTab(mode){
  const isLogin = mode === 'login';
  document.getElementById('tabLoginBtn').classList.toggle('active', isLogin);
  document.getElementById('tabSignupBtn').classList.toggle('active', !isLogin);
  document.getElementById('loginPanel').style.display = isLogin ? 'block' : 'none';
  document.getElementById('signupPanel').style.display = isLogin ? 'none' : 'block';
  if(!isLogin && !document.getElementById('suStartDate').value){
    document.getElementById('suStartDate').value = todayStr();
    updateSignupTimelinePreview();
  }
}

function completeUserLogin(email){
  loadUserSession(email);
  hideAuthScreen();
  const t = todayStr();
  document.getElementById('f-date').value = t;
  resetTodayForm(t);
  renderHeader();
  renderLockUI();
  renderTodayStatus();
  const activeTab = document.querySelector('.tab-btn.active').dataset.tab;
  switchTab(activeTab);
  showToast('Signed in as ' + usersDb[email].name);
}

function handleLoginSubmit(){
  const email = document.getElementById('loginEmail').value.trim().toLowerCase();
  const pass = document.getElementById('loginPassword').value;
  if(!email || !pass){
    showToast('Enter both your email address and password');
    return;
  }
  const matchedKey = Object.keys(usersDb).find(k=>k.toLowerCase()===email);
  if(!matchedKey){
    showToast('No account found for that email \u2014 switch to Sign Up & Subscribe');
    return;
  }
  const user = usersDb[matchedKey];
  if(user.password !== pass){
    showToast('Incorrect password \u2014 try again or use 1-Tap Sign In below');
    return;
  }
  document.getElementById('loginPassword').value = '';
  completeUserLogin(matchedKey);
}

function handleSignupSubmit(){
  const name = document.getElementById('suName').value.trim();
  const email = document.getElementById('suEmail').value.trim().toLowerCase();
  const password = document.getElementById('suPassword').value;
  const firm = document.getElementById('suFirm').value.trim() || 'Grant Thornton Anjum Rahman';
  const startDate = document.getElementById('suStartDate').value;
  const allowedLeaves = parseInt(document.getElementById('suAllowedLeaves').value) || 130;

  if(!name){ showToast('Enter your full name'); return; }
  if(!email || !email.includes('@')){ showToast('Enter a valid email address'); return; }
  if(!password || password.length < 4){ showToast('Password must be at least 4 characters'); return; }
  if(!startDate){ showToast('Select the starting date of your articleship'); return; }

  const existingKey = Object.keys(usersDb).find(k=>k.toLowerCase()===email);
  if(existingKey){
    showToast('An account with this email already exists \u2014 please Log In');
    switchAuthTab('login');
    document.getElementById('loginEmail').value = email;
    return;
  }

  if(selectedPayMethod === 'card' && !document.getElementById('suCardNumber').value.trim()){
    showToast('Enter your card details to activate subscription');
    return;
  }
  if(selectedPayMethod === 'wallet' && !document.getElementById('suWalletNumber').value.trim()){
    showToast('Enter your JazzCash / EasyPaisa number');
    return;
  }
  if(selectedPayMethod === 'code' && !document.getElementById('suPromoCode').value.trim()){
    showToast('Enter your firm or promo access code');
    return;
  }

  const endDate = calculateArticleshipEndDate(startDate);
  const planNames = {
    monthly: 'Monthly Plan (PKR 499/mo)',
    annual: 'Annual Plan (PKR 4,499/yr)',
    lifetime: 'Full 3.5-Year Articleship Pass'
  };
  let expiryDate = endDate;
  const nowD = new Date();
  if(selectedSignupPlan === 'monthly'){
    const d = new Date(nowD.getFullYear(), nowD.getMonth()+1, nowD.getDate());
    expiryDate = d.getFullYear()+'-'+String(d.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,'0')+'-'+String(d.getDate()).padStart(2,'0');
  } else if(selectedSignupPlan === 'annual'){
    const d = new Date(nowD.getFullYear()+1, nowD.getMonth(), nowD.getDate());
    expiryDate = d.getFullYear()+'-'+String(d.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,'0')+'-'+String(d.getDate()).padStart(2,'0');
  }

  usersDb[email] = {
    name,
    email,
    password,
    firm,
    articleshipStart: startDate,
    articleshipEnd: endDate,
    subscription: {
      plan: planNames[selectedSignupPlan] || 'Annual Plan',
      planCode: selectedSignupPlan,
      status: 'active',
      expiry: expiryDate
    },
    entries: {},
    settings: { allowed: allowedLeaves, adjustment: 0, locked: false },
    clients: {
      'GT - Islamabad': { periods: [] }
    },
    deletedEntries: {}
  };

  saveUsersDb();
  completeUserLogin(email);
  showToast(`Welcome ${name}! Articleship ends ${fmtDate(endDate)}`);
}

function openProfileModal(){
  const u = usersDb[currentUserEmail];
  if(!u) return;
  document.getElementById('profNameInput').value = u.name || '';
  document.getElementById('profEmailInput').value = u.email || '';
  document.getElementById('profFirmInput').value = u.firm || '';
  document.getElementById('profStartInput').value = u.articleshipStart || ARTICLESHIP_START;
  document.getElementById('profEndInput').value = calculateArticleshipEndDate(u.articleshipStart || ARTICLESHIP_START);
  document.getElementById('profPlanLabel').textContent = (u.subscription && u.subscription.plan) || 'Active Plan';
  const isAct = u.subscription && u.subscription.status === 'active';
  document.getElementById('profSubStatusLabel').textContent = isAct ? 'Active (Paid)' : 'Expired (Payment Due)';
  document.getElementById('profSubStatusLabel').style.color = isAct ? 'var(--present)' : 'var(--absent)';
  document.getElementById('profSubExpiryLabel').textContent = (u.subscription && u.subscription.expiry) ? fmtDate(u.subscription.expiry) : fmtDate(ARTICLESHIP_END);
  document.getElementById('toggleSubStatusBtn').textContent = isAct ? 'Simulate Expiry' : 'Renew Subscription Now';
  document.getElementById('profileModalBg').classList.add('show');
}

function closeProfileModal(){
  document.getElementById('profileModalBg').classList.remove('show');
}

function saveProfileChanges(){
  const u = usersDb[currentUserEmail];
  if(!u) return;
  const newName = document.getElementById('profNameInput').value.trim();
  const newFirm = document.getElementById('profFirmInput').value.trim();
  const newStart = document.getElementById('profStartInput').value;
  if(!newName){ showToast('Name cannot be empty'); return; }
  if(!newStart){ showToast('Articleship start date is required'); return; }
  u.name = newName;
  u.firm = newFirm || 'Grant Thornton Anjum Rahman';
  u.articleshipStart = newStart;
  u.articleshipEnd = calculateArticleshipEndDate(newStart);
  ARTICLESHIP_START = u.articleshipStart;
  ARTICLESHIP_END = u.articleshipEnd;
  calendarBuilt = false;
  populateRemarkDropdowns();
  syncActiveUserToDb();
  renderHeader();
  const activeTab = document.querySelector('.tab-btn.active').dataset.tab;
  if(activeTab === 'log') renderLog();
  closeProfileModal();
  showToast(`Timeline updated: ${fmtDate(ARTICLESHIP_START)} \u2192 ${fmtDate(ARTICLESHIP_END)}`);
}

// ---------- Init ----------
async function init(){
  await loadData();
  document.getElementById('f-date').value = todayStr();
  resetTodayForm(todayStr());
  populateDeptList();
  renderHeader();
  renderInstallBanner();
  renderLockUI();
  renderTodayStatus();
  initGoogleAuth();
  initSwipeNav();

  document.getElementById('balChip').addEventListener('click', ()=>switchTab('balance'));
  document.getElementById('dayCountChip').addEventListener('click', ()=>switchTab('log'));
  document.getElementById('daysLeftChip').addEventListener('click', ()=>switchTab('log'));
  document.getElementById('lockToggleBtn').addEventListener('click', toggleLock);
  document.getElementById('markRangeBtn').addEventListener('click', markLeaveRange);
  document.getElementById('exportDataBtn').addEventListener('click', exportData);
  document.getElementById('importMergeBtn').addEventListener('click', ()=>{
    const file = document.getElementById('importFileInput').files[0];
    importAndMerge(file);
  });

  document.getElementById('syncBtn').addEventListener('click', ()=>{
    if(signedIn) return;
    if(tokenClient) tokenClient.requestAccessToken({prompt:''});
    else showToast('Google sign-in is still loading \u2014 try again in a moment');
  });
  document.getElementById('switchAccountBtn').addEventListener('click', ()=>{
    if(tokenClient) tokenClient.requestAccessToken({prompt:'select_account'});
    else showToast('Google sign-in is still loading \u2014 try again in a moment');
  });

  document.querySelectorAll('#statusSeg button').forEach(b=>{
    b.addEventListener('click', ()=>setStatus(b.dataset.s));
  });
  document.getElementById('addWorkBtn').addEventListener('click', ()=>addWorkRow('',''));
  document.getElementById('saveBtn').addEventListener('click', saveToday);
  document.getElementById('deleteEntryBtn').addEventListener('click', ()=>{
    deleteEntryWithConfirm(document.getElementById('f-date').value);
  });
  document.getElementById('f-date').addEventListener('change', (e)=>resetTodayForm(e.target.value));
  document.getElementById('f-dept').addEventListener('change', refreshWorkRowClientOptions);

  document.getElementById('openAddClientBtn').addEventListener('click', ()=>{
    document.getElementById('newClientNameInput').value = '';
    document.getElementById('newClientPeriodInput').value = '';
    document.getElementById('newClientDeptInput').value = document.getElementById('f-dept').value || 'Audit';
    document.getElementById('addClientModalBg').classList.add('show');
    document.getElementById('newClientNameInput').focus();
  });
  document.getElementById('closeAddClientModal').addEventListener('click', ()=>{
    document.getElementById('addClientModalBg').classList.remove('show');
  });
  document.getElementById('addClientModalBg').addEventListener('click', (e)=>{
    if(e.target.id==='addClientModalBg') document.getElementById('addClientModalBg').classList.remove('show');
  });
  document.getElementById('confirmAddClientBtn').addEventListener('click', async ()=>{
    const name = document.getElementById('newClientNameInput').value;
    const period = document.getElementById('newClientPeriodInput').value;
    const dept = document.getElementById('newClientDeptInput').value;
    if(!name.trim()){ showToast('Enter a client name'); return; }
    await addClient(name, period, dept);
    document.getElementById('addClientModalBg').classList.remove('show');
  });
  document.getElementById('pieChart').addEventListener('click', ()=>{
    pieView = pieView==='dept' ? 'client' : 'dept';
    renderPieChart();
  });

  document.querySelectorAll('.tab-btn').forEach(b=>{
    b.addEventListener('click', ()=>switchTab(b.dataset.tab));
  });
  document.getElementById('calScroll').addEventListener('click', (e)=>{
    const cell = e.target.closest('.cal-day.has-entry');
    if(cell) openDayDetail(cell.dataset.date);
  });
  document.getElementById('closeModal').addEventListener('click', closeDayModal);
  document.getElementById('editModalBg').addEventListener('click', (e)=>{ if(e.target.id==='editModalBg') closeDayModal(); });

  document.getElementById('saveSettingsBtn').addEventListener('click', async ()=>{
    settings.allowed = parseInt(document.getElementById('s-allowed').value)||130;
    await persistSettings();
    renderBalance(); renderHeader();
    showToast('Settings saved');
  });
  document.getElementById('b-adj').addEventListener('change', async (e)=>{
    settings.adjustment = parseInt(e.target.value)||0;
    await persistSettings();
    renderBalance(); renderHeader();
  });

  // Delete confirmation modal listeners
  document.getElementById('closeConfirmDeleteModal').addEventListener('click', ()=>{
    document.getElementById('confirmDeleteModalBg').classList.remove('show');
  });
  document.getElementById('cancelDeleteBtn').addEventListener('click', ()=>{
    document.getElementById('confirmDeleteModalBg').classList.remove('show');
  });
  document.getElementById('confirmDeleteModalBg').addEventListener('click', (e)=>{
    if(e.target.id==='confirmDeleteModalBg') document.getElementById('confirmDeleteModalBg').classList.remove('show');
  });
  document.getElementById('confirmDeleteYesBtn').addEventListener('click', executeConfirmedDelete);

  // Auth & Subscription listeners
  document.getElementById('logoutBtn').addEventListener('click', ()=>{
    try{ localStorage.removeItem('leave-tracker-current-user-v2'); }catch(e){}
    showAuthScreen('login');
  });
  document.getElementById('tabLoginBtn').addEventListener('click', ()=>switchAuthTab('login'));
  document.getElementById('tabSignupBtn').addEventListener('click', ()=>switchAuthTab('signup'));
  document.getElementById('loginSubmitBtn').addEventListener('click', handleLoginSubmit);
  document.getElementById('loginPassword').addEventListener('keydown', (e)=>{
    if(e.key==='Enter') handleLoginSubmit();
  });
  document.getElementById('suStartDate').addEventListener('change', updateSignupTimelinePreview);
  document.getElementById('suStartDate').addEventListener('input', updateSignupTimelinePreview);

  document.querySelectorAll('#suPlanGrid .plan-card').forEach(card=>{
    card.addEventListener('click', ()=>{
      selectedSignupPlan = card.dataset.plan;
      document.querySelectorAll('#suPlanGrid .plan-card').forEach(c=>c.classList.toggle('sel', c.dataset.plan===selectedSignupPlan));
    });
  });
  document.querySelectorAll('#suPayMethods button').forEach(btn=>{
    btn.addEventListener('click', ()=>{
      selectedPayMethod = btn.dataset.pay;
      document.querySelectorAll('#suPayMethods button').forEach(b=>b.classList.toggle('sel', b.dataset.pay===selectedPayMethod));
      document.getElementById('payFieldsCard').style.display = selectedPayMethod==='card' ? 'block' : 'none';
      document.getElementById('payFieldsWallet').style.display = selectedPayMethod==='wallet' ? 'block' : 'none';
      document.getElementById('payFieldsCode').style.display = selectedPayMethod==='code' ? 'block' : 'none';
    });
  });
  document.getElementById('signupSubmitBtn').addEventListener('click', handleSignupSubmit);

  // Profile & Subscription modal listeners
  document.getElementById('openProfileModalBtn').addEventListener('click', openProfileModal);
  document.getElementById('hdrSubBadge').style.cursor = 'pointer';
  document.getElementById('hdrSubBadge').addEventListener('click', openProfileModal);
  document.getElementById('closeProfileModal').addEventListener('click', closeProfileModal);
  document.getElementById('profileModalBg').addEventListener('click', (e)=>{
    if(e.target.id==='profileModalBg') closeProfileModal();
  });
  document.getElementById('profStartInput').addEventListener('change', (e)=>{
    document.getElementById('profEndInput').value = calculateArticleshipEndDate(e.target.value);
  });
  document.getElementById('saveProfileBtn').addEventListener('click', saveProfileChanges);
  document.getElementById('toggleSubStatusBtn').addEventListener('click', ()=>{
    const u = usersDb[currentUserEmail];
    if(!u) return;
    if(!u.subscription) u.subscription = { plan: 'Annual Plan', status: 'active', expiry: ARTICLESHIP_END };
    u.subscription.status = u.subscription.status === 'active' ? 'expired' : 'active';
    saveUsersDb();
    renderHeader();
    openProfileModal();
    showToast(u.subscription.status === 'active' ? 'Subscription renewed & active!' : 'Subscription marked expired (recording locked)');
  });
  document.getElementById('upgradePlanBtn').addEventListener('click', ()=>{
    const u = usersDb[currentUserEmail];
    if(!u) return;
    u.subscription = {
      plan: 'Full 3.5-Year Articleship Pass',
      planCode: 'lifetime',
      status: 'active',
      expiry: u.articleshipEnd || ARTICLESHIP_END
    };
    saveUsersDb();
    renderHeader();
    openProfileModal();
    showToast('Upgraded to Full 3.5-Year Articleship Pass!');
  });
}
init();
</script>
</body>
</html>
